A small number of platforms - including Spotify, YouTube, Apple Music, and TikTok - now operate as crucial intermediaries between artists and audiences, wielding significant algorithmic, data, and commercial power. While digital services have broadened access and stimulated new creative practices, they have also concentrated economic and informational power in ways that raise urgent questions of fairness in remuneration, visibility, participation, and governance.

This White Paper presents the findings and policy recommendations of Fair MusE (Promoting Fairness of the Music Ecosystem in a Platform-Dominated and Post-Pandemic Europe), a Horizon Europe project bringing together legal scholars, economists, and data scientists in ongoing dialogue with creators, collective management organisations, and policymakers. The paper identifies three interlocking sources of systemic imbalance: persistent barriers to fair remuneration and contractual parity for creators and smaller intermediaries, despite the rights introduced by the 2019 DSM Directive; pervasive data and algorithmic opacity that limits the ability of creators, researchers, and regulators to scrutinise the systems shaping cultural visibility and value; and institutional fragmentation across EU policy fields - from copyright and cultural policy to platform regulation and competition law - that weakens enforcement and inhibits a coherent European strategy.

The paper argues that metadata quality, interoperable data infrastructures, and algorithmic accountability are central preconditions for fairness, not secondary concerns. It further contends that fairness in the digital music ecosystem is fundamentally a governance challenge: digital markets do not merely distribute content, they shape cultural memory, linguistic plurality, and the conditions under which artistic work can flourish.

The policy recommendations integrate substantive creator rights under the DSM Directive, structural transparency obligations under the DSA and DMA, cultural diversity objectives under Article 167 TFEU and the UNESCO Convention on Cultural Diversity, and competition principles within a unified framework. Key proposals include strengthening copyright enforcement and harmonisation; embedding algorithmic transparency and accountability; establishing a European Music Data Space; creating a permanent EU Music Observatory; and developing fairness metrics and diversity-by-design standards for recommender systems.

Implemented together, these measures offer a practical roadmap for ensuring that Europe's digital transition enhances - rather than undermines - the sustainability, plurality, and richness of its cultural ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Horizon Europe的Fair MusE项目，系统分析了平台主导时代数字音乐生态系统中存在的不公平问题，指出持续存在的报酬不平等、数据和算法不透明、以及欧盟政策碎片化是三大系统性失衡根源，并提出了包括强化版权执行、算法透明度、建立欧洲音乐数据空间和永久性音乐观测站等综合性政策建议。
AI.research_question: 在平台主导的后疫情时代欧洲，数字音乐生态系统面临哪些系统性不公平问题？如何通过综合性政策框架实现公平性？
AI.motivation: 数字服务虽然扩大了音乐获取渠道并激发了新的创作实践，但同时也将经济和信息权力集中在少数平台（Spotify、YouTube、Apple Music、TikTok等）手中，引发了报酬公平性、可见性、参与度和治理等方面的紧迫问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该论文整合了多个政策与理论框架：DSM指令下的创作者权利、DSA和DMA下的结构性透明度义务、TFEU第167条及联合国教科文组织《文化多样性公约》下的文化多样性目标，以及竞争法原则。
AI.method: 作为Horizon Europe项目白皮书，整合了法律学者、经济学家和数据科学家的跨学科研究，并与创作者、集体管理组织和政策制定者进行持续对话。
AI.findings: 识别出三大系统性失衡根源：（1）尽管有2019年DSM指令，创作者和中小型中介仍面临公平报酬和合同平等的持续障碍；（2）数据和算法不透明性限制了创作者、研究者和监管者审视文化可见性和价值形成机制的能力；（3）欧盟版权、文化政策、平台监管和竞争法等领域的制度碎片化削弱了执行效果。此外，元数据质量、可互操作的数据基础设施和算法问责制是实现公平的核心前提。
AI.theory_contributions: 将公平性问题重新定义为治理挑战，论证数字市场不仅是内容分发渠道，更是塑造文化记忆、语言多样性和艺术创作条件的核心机制。提出应将元数据、数据互操作性和算法问责制视为公平性的核心前提而非次要关切。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出综合性政策建议：强化版权执行与协调、嵌入算法透明度与问责制、建立欧洲音乐数据空间、创建永久性欧盟音乐观测站、为推荐系统开发公平性指标和多样性设计标准。这些措施为解决平台经济中文化生态系统的可持续性、多元性和丰富性提供了可操作的路线图。

title: From Farm Gate to Market Queen: Structural Drivers of Horticultural Postharvest Losses in Ghana

detail.title: From Farm Gate to Market Queen: Structural Drivers of Horticultural Postharvest Losses in Ghana
detail.abstract: Ghana's agricultural sector contributes approximately 20-21% of GDP and employs roughly 35% of the national workforce. Despite significant investment in crop production, a structural crisis continues to undermine agricultural gains: postharvest losses (PHLs) in the horticultural sub-sector covering tomatoes, peppers, leafy vegetables, and other perishable crops are estimated at 30-50% of total annual production. These losses translate to an estimated $295-385 million in foregone revenue each year from the horticultural sub-sector alone, threatening national food security, smallholder livelihoods, and Ghana's broader agro-industrialization agenda. The core structural constraint is a near-total absence of integrated, reliable, and affordable cold chain infrastructure connecting smallholder farmers to domestic markets and export channels. The result is a system characterized by excessive field-to-market transit times, inadequate storage, poor packaging, and negligible access to refrigerated logistics conditions that accelerate microbial spoilage, mechanical damage, and physiological deterioration of produce. This paper adopts a systematic review methodology, combining a structured review of peer reviewed literature and institutional reports on postharvest losses (PHLs) in Ghana and comparable Sub-Saharan African contexts, a secondary-data value chain analysis of the tomato and pepper supply corridors, stakeholder mapping of actors from farm to final market, and a comparative analysis of cold chain policy interventions in Kenya, Ethiopia, and South Africa. The paper finds that PHLs are not primarily a technology problem but a governance and investment coordination failure: market incentives are misaligned, public investment has been fragmented and underfunded, extension services inadequately cover postharvest handling, and smallholder farmers cannot individually bear the capital cost of cold chain infrastructure. Building on these findings, the paper proposes a five-pillar National Postharvest Cold Chain Policy Framework (NPCCPF): a dedicated National Postharvest Development Fund (NPDF), a district-level Community Cold Hubs (CCHs) network across high-production districts, mandatory postharvest handling standards and their enforcement, an integrated postharvest extension framework, and public-private partnerships (PPPs) for refrigerated logistics and agro-processing linkages. The framework is designed to produce measurable reductions in horticultural PHLs, expand agro-logistics employment, and improve farmgate prices for targeted commodities.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了加纳园艺产业采后损失的结构性原因，指出问题核心并非技术缺失，而是治理与投资协调失灵。基于系统综述、价值链分析和国际比较，提出了包含国家采后发展基金、社区冷库网络、采后处理标准、推广体系改革和公私合作伙伴关系五大支柱的冷链政策框架。
AI.research_question: 加纳园艺产业采后损失（PHLs）的深层结构性原因是什么？如何通过政策框架系统性地减少采后损失？
AI.motivation: 加纳园艺产业采后损失高达30-50%（年度经济损失约2.95-3.85亿美元），严重威胁粮食安全、小农生计和农业工业化进程，而现有干预措施效果有限，需从系统层面重新审视问题根源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理与投资协调失灵理论：采后损失问题被重新定义为市场激励错配、公共投资碎片化、推广服务不足和小农资本约束等系统性治理问题，而非单纯的技术缺口。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述法，结合同行评审文献和机构报告审查、基于二手数据的番茄和辣椒供应链价值链分析、从农场到市场的利益相关者图谱、以及肯尼亚、埃塞俄比亚和南非的冷链政策干预比较分析。
AI.findings: 采后损失主要源于治理和投资协调失灵而非技术不足；市场激励错配、公共投资碎片化且资金不足、推广服务覆盖采后处理不足、小农无力承担冷链基础设施的资本成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 将采后损失问题从技术导向重新定义为治理与制度失灵问题，拓展了农业价值链治理理论在采后管理领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体的、可操作的"国家采后冷链政策框架（NPCCPF）"，包含国家采后发展基金、社区冷库网络、强制性采后标准、推广体系改革和公私合作伙伴关系五大支柱，并设计了可衡量的产出目标。

title: Germany’s Economic Crossroads: Stagnation, Structural Challenges and Policy Reponses

detail.title: Germany’s Economic Crossroads: Stagnation, Structural Challenges and Policy Reponses
detail.abstract: Germany, recognized as the economic powerhouse of Europe with a gross domestic product (GDP) of 4,305 billion euros in 2024, is recently facing persistent economic stagnation. While other nations in Europe have reported a remarkable 5% growth in GDP, Germanys performance remains sluggish, particularly due to series of economic burdens and structural challenges (Glunz & von Prittwitz, 2023). Several economic burdens contributed to its downturn. The Covid-19 pandemic triggered logistics disruptions and labor shortages, straining the industry resources and productions. The high energy prices exacerbated by geopolitical conflicts (Russia-Ukraine war) increased inflation, impacting both consumers and corporations. Additionally, Germanys high reliance on China exports backfired, pulling down one of the biggest sources of income, exports and trades especially in automobile industry. Escalating demographic challenges such as aging population and declining workforce are further deepening the crisis. Such erratic situations have led to a vicious circle of turbulent instability and financial fragility in recent years leading to a 4.58% decline in GDP (2022) (initial impact of crisis). It has been challenging traditional business frameworks and compelling businesses to adjust their production process (DIW Berlin: German Economy Currently Scarcely Making Headway, 2023). Even though Germany is the third largest economy in the world, such headwinds can lead Germany into a recession if they are not being addressed. Therefore, this report empirically evaluates the economic situation of Germany, its impact on key stake holders and the effectiveness of governments response to stabilize the economy henceforth, providing an outline to navigate the challenges and ensure economic long-term sustainability

AI.tldr: 本文实证评估了德国当前面临的经济停滞问题，分析了新冠疫情、能源危机、对华出口依赖、人口老龄化等多重结构性挑战对德国经济的影响，并评估了政府应对措施的有效性，最后为德国经济长期可持续发展提供建议。
AI.research_question: 德国当前经济停滞的成因是什么？这些因素如何影响关键利益相关者？德国政府的应对措施是否有效？如何确保德国经济的长期可持续性？
AI.motivation: 德国作为欧洲经济引擎和全球第三大经济体，正面临持续性经济停滞与衰退风险。尽管其他欧洲国家实现5%经济增长，德国表现却持续低迷，若不加干预可能陷入衰退。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济危机理论、结构性经济转型理论、宏观经济稳定政策理论
AI.method: 实证评估方法，综合数据分析经济指标、利益相关者影响及政策有效性
AI.findings: 德国经济面临多重结构性挑战：新冠疫情导致供应链中断和劳动力短缺；俄乌冲突推高能源价格加剧通胀；过度依赖中国出口市场（尤其汽车行业）导致贸易收入下滑；人口老龄化与劳动力萎缩进一步恶化经济危机，2022年GDP下降4.58%。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了多重外部冲击（疫情、地缘冲突）与内部结构性问题（人口老龄化、出口依赖）对发达经济体影响的综合分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为德国政策制定者提供应对经济停滞的具体策略建议，帮助企业调整生产流程以适应新经济环境，为其他面临类似挑战的发达经济体提供参考。

title: Auxiliary Benefits and the Fiscal Sustainability of Social Security in an Aging Economy
affiliations: Otaru University of Commerce

detail.title: Auxiliary Benefits and the Fiscal Sustainability of Social Security in an Aging Economy
detail.abstract: This paper studies the impact of auxiliary benefits on the sustainability of Social Security in an aging economy. I develop a computable overlapping generations model with heterogeneous households in which individuals may be single or married, face marriage and divorce risks, and may become widowed, thereby explicitly incorporating auxiliary benefits into the analysis. Using the calibrated model, I simulate an aging economy to quantify the additional taxes required to sustain the Social Security system. The results show that auxiliary benefits significantly increase the fiscal burden and that the gap in required taxes between economies with and without auxiliary benefits widens as the population ages. This gap remains substantial even when the retirement age is raised. The analysis provides quantitative insights into the macroeconomic and fiscal effects of auxiliary benefits. Moreover, incorporating marriage and divorce risks is essential; otherwise, the fiscal impact of auxiliary benefits is overstated.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建包含婚姻、离婚和丧偶风险的异质性世代交叠模型，量化分析了辅助福利（如配偶、遗属福利）对老龄化社会社保体系财政可持续性的影响。研究发现辅助福利显著加重了社保的财政负担，且随人口老龄化加剧，这一负担与无辅助福利经济体之间的税收差距持续扩大，即使提高退休年龄也难以消除。此外，忽略婚姻与离婚风险会高估辅助福利的财政影响。
AI.research_question: 在人口老龄化背景下，辅助福利（auxiliary benefits）如何影响社会保障体系的财政可持续性？
AI.motivation: 社会保障体系的财政可持续性在人口老龄化下面临严峻挑战，而辅助福利（如配偶福利、遗属福利）作为社保支出的重要组成部分，其对财政负担的量化影响尚缺乏系统研究。此外，现有模型往往忽略家庭内部的婚姻、离婚和丧偶动态，可能造成对辅助福利财政效应的错误估计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可计算世代交叠（OLG）模型；异质性家庭模型（包括单身、已婚状态，及婚姻、离婚、丧偶风险）。
AI.method: 构建包含婚姻状态转换风险的异质性OLG模型，利用校准后的模型模拟老龄化经济，量化不同情景下维持社保体系所需的额外税收。
AI.findings: （1）辅助福利显著增加了社保体系的财政负担；（2）随着人口老龄化加剧，有辅助福利与无辅助福利经济体所需的税收缺口持续扩大；（3）即使提高退休年龄，这一税收缺口依然显著；（4）忽略婚姻与离婚风险会夸大辅助福利的财政影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在OLG框架中系统纳入婚姻、离婚和丧偶风险以精确评估辅助福利对社保可持续性的影响，揭示了家庭动态在社保财政分析中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于辅助福利财政成本的量化依据，提示在老龄化改革（如延迟退休）中需审慎考虑辅助福利的长期负担，并强调了在政策模拟中纳入家庭结构动态的必要性。

title: Brief of Amicus Curiae Dr. Ron D. Katznelson in Support of Affirmance in Microsoft Corp. v. i4i Limited Partnership, US Supreme Court Case No. 10-290
affiliations: Bi-Level Technologies

detail.title: Brief of Amicus Curiae Dr. Ron D. Katznelson in Support of Affirmance in Microsoft Corp. v. i4i Limited Partnership, US Supreme Court Case No. 10-290

keywords: proof by clear and convincing evidence

detail.abstract:
Civil cases involving litigants having countervailing interests of substantial disparity, prescribe the heightened standard of proof as a “default.” In re Winship, 397 U.S. 358, 371 (1970) (Harlan, J., concurring); Santosky v. Kramer, 455 U.S. 745, 758 (1982). The substantial disparity in the countervailing risks of loss in patent invalidity proceedings leads to the “default” heightened standard of proof which has been applied in patent law for more than 150 years.

The fundamental principle that governs the standard of proof generally under this Court’s jurisprudence involves allocating the risk of factfinder errors between the litigants in a manner that reflects their relative expected risk (harm in the event of an error). Addington v. Texas 441 U.S. 418, 423 (1979). Thus, a higher burden of proof will be required for a verdict against the litigant that will suffer harm that is substantially greater than that suffered by the adverse litigant under erroneous decisions. The degree of asymmetry in the countervailing risks to the litigants determines the standard of proof. Symmetry of the risks among litigants – where both parties have equal risks – creates the ‘preponderance of the evidence’ standard; high asymmetry corresponds to the ‘clear and convincing evidence’ standard; and extremely high asymmetry corresponds to the ‘beyond reasonable doubt’ standard, often used in criminal law.

In contrast with infringement adjudication errors where the litigants face comparable risks, the countervailing risks of error in patent invalidity proceedings are vastly different in magnitude for each litigant. Whereas the alleged infringer’s risk in an adverse decision amounts only to damages incurred by his own infringing activity, the patentee’s risk under an error against him is that of losing the patent rights altogether, losing recovery not only from the alleged infringer but from all other parties. Under such errors, the patentee would be unlikely to receive returns on investments made in discovery and development of the invention – investments made in reliance on the patent bargain. In addition, when the factfinder erroneously invalidates the patent, the patentee suffers irreparable harm brought about by the public disclosure of the invention required in exchange for the patent grant. (The accused infringer and the public are unjustly enriched). Thus, the quid pro quo of the patent bargain transfers much of the risk of loss to the patentee – a risk not sustained by other parties.

Therefore, the patent bargain and the associated highly asymmetric risks that it imparts on the parties command the “default” heightened standard of proof that apply under this Court’s precedents. This requirement does not originate from the patent statute. Rather, it is based on immutable legal principles rooted in traditional American jurisprudence as reaffirmed in Winship and Santosky – prescribing unconditionally heightened standard of proof whenever the magnitude of the countervailing interests of the litigants are highly asymmetric. Such is the case in patent invalidity proceedings.

The heightened standard of proof operates regardless of whether or not administrative deference to PTO examination is due. It is an inevitable result grounded in the fundamental principles in Winship and Santosky. As shown in Section V, because these principles have long been a legal tradition, the heightened standard of proof appears to have prevailed even before the PTO started examining patent applications in 1836. Petitioner provides no evidence that a preponderance of evidence standard existed prior to 1836, when the U.S. was operating a patent registration system. Rather, despite the lower confidence the public had in the validity of patents, evidence provided in Section V suggests that during that time the courts had nevertheless conducted adjudications in a manner consistent with the heightened standard.

The heightened standard in the presumption of validity is therefore a basic doctrine of the patent bargain which produces substantial disparity in the countervailing risks of error. The presumption is established when the PTO grants the patent, whether or not the PTO examined it for novelty, non-anticipation, or non-obviousness. Congress’ enactment of PTO examination procedures in 1836 was aimed not at establishing the presumption of validity but rather at further justifying its existence. For the reasons stated above and further elaborated below, the Federal Circuit’s judgment should be affirmed.

AI.tldr: 本文论证在专利无效程序中应适用“明确且有说服力的证据”这一提高的证明标准，源于双方当事人在错误判决中面临的高度不对称风险，这是美国传统法学中固有的基本原则，而非专利法成文法的要求。
AI.research_question: 专利无效程序中应适用何种证明标准？提高的证明标准（明确且有说服力的证据）的法律依据是什么？
AI.motivation: 专利无效程序中原被告双方在事实认定错误时面临的风险存在严重不对称（专利人可能丧失整个专利权及所有投资回报，而侵权人仅承担自身侵权损害赔偿），这种风险不对称要求适用比“优势证据”更高的证明标准，以保护专利人的合法权益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 风险分配理论：证明标准的核心是在诉讼双方之间分配事实认定错误的风险，风险不对称程度决定证明标准的高低。2. 专利对价理论（Patent Bargain）：专利人以公开发明为代价获得有限垄断权，错误无效专利将破坏这一对价关系，使专利人承担不成比例的损失。
AI.method: 法律推理与判例分析法。通过分析Winship、Santosky、Addington等最高法院判例确立的证明标准原则，结合专利对价理论的内在逻辑，论证专利无效程序应适用提高的证明标准。
AI.findings: 1. 专利无效程序中双方错误风险高度不对称，符合适用提高证明标准的条件。2. 提高的证明标准并非源于专利成文法，而是美国传统法学中独立存在的根本原则。3. 该标准在1836年专利审查制度建立前即已存在，不受行政尊让原则影响。4. 专利有效性推定是专利对价的基本教义，审查制度的建立只是进一步正当化而非创立该推定。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统阐释了证明标准与风险不对称之间的理论对应关系（对称→优势证据；高不对称→明确且有说服力的证据；极高不对称→排除合理怀疑）。2. 将专利无效程序中的证明标准问题提升至宪法性正当程序原则层面，而非仅停留在专利法解释层面。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为专利无效程序中坚持提高的证明标准提供了坚实的法律理论依据。2. 明确了该标准独立于专利审查制度（即使未经过实质审查的专利权也应享有该保护）。3. 对联邦巡回法院的判决提供了支持性论证，对专利诉讼实践具有指导意义。

title: MediaWiki Code2Code Search: Neural Retrieval for the Semantic Discovery of Open-Source Software Entities
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: MediaWiki Code2Code Search: Neural Retrieval for the Semantic Discovery of Open-Source Software Entities
detail.abstract: Code search in large-scale ecosystems is often hindered by the lexical gap between user queries and implementation details, alongside the trade-off between the low latency of traditional Information Retrieval (IR) and the precision of Deep Learning (DL). We present MediaWiki Code2Code Search, a neural retrieval system for semantic code-to-code discovery. By indexing 1.29 million structural entities (functions, types, and templates) across 2,500+ MediaWiki repositories, our system enables retrieval based on computational intent rather than surface tokens. We employ a split-build architecture, decoupling GPU-intensive offline indexing from a CPU-only serving layer; our FAISS IVF-PQ index occupies 168.6 MB: a 96.6\% reduction compared to a flat float32 baseline, and achieves a median query latency of 1.85 seconds on commodity hardware, satisfying the 6 GiB RAM constraint of Wikimedia Toolforge. Our evaluation across a 27-query benchmark demonstrates superior performance over the BM25 baseline, achieving a P@10 of 0.87 compared to 0.64 (0.52 versus 0.34 for strict matching). Gains are most pronounced in name-obfuscated tasks where lexical methods fail. The system is available at code2codesearch.toolforge.org under the Apache 2.0 licence and provides an open RESTful API.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个面向MediaWiki生态系统的神经代码检索系统，通过分体架构（GPU离线索引+CPU在线服务）和FAISS IVF-PQ索引压缩，在低资源约束下实现了基于语义意图的代码搜索，显著优于BM25基线。
AI.research_question: 如何在大型软件生态系统中克服词法鸿沟（用户查询与实现细节之间的语义差距），并在低延迟要求下实现高效的语义代码搜索？
AI.motivation: 传统IR方法（如BM25）受限于词法匹配，在处理命名混淆等任务时表现不佳；而深度学习检索方法虽然精度高，但延迟较高。MediaWiki生态系统拥有2500+仓库和百万级结构实体，亟需一种兼顾低延迟与高精度的语义代码搜索方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 神经检索（Neural Retrieval）、语义代码嵌入（Semantic Code Embedding）、向量索引压缩（FAISS IVF-PQ）
AI.method: 1) 构建1.29百万结构实体（函数、类型、模板）的索引；2) 采用分体架构（split-build）：GPU进行离线稠密向量索引构建，CPU处理在线查询服务；3) 使用FAISS IVF-PQ将索引压缩至168.6 MB（相比float32基线减少96.6%）；4) 在27个查询基准上进行评估，与BM25基线对比。
AI.findings: 系统在中位延迟1.85秒下运行（满足6 GiB RAM约束）；P@10达0.87（BM25为0.64），严格匹配P@10为0.52（BM25为0.34）；在命名混淆任务上优势最为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了在资源受限环境中，通过分体架构和量化压缩技术，神经检索可以在保持语义理解优势的同时达到可接受的延迟水平，为低资源环境下的语义代码搜索提供了可行范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了一个面向MediaWiki生态系统的开源语义代码搜索工具（code2codesearch.toolforge.org）；2) 展示了如何在大规模代码库中以极小的内存足迹实现高效神经检索；3) 为Wikimedia Toolforge等资源受限平台提供了可部署的语义搜索解决方案。

reference: University of Baltimore School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper
title: Bodies in the Beds: How REITs, Private Equity Firms, and County Hospitals Monetize Nursing Home Residents as Real Estate Acquisitions
affiliations: University of Baltimore - School of Law

detail.title: Bodies in the Beds: How REITs, Private Equity Firms, and County Hospitals Monetize Nursing Home Residents as Real Estate Acquisitions

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Baltimore School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Baltimore School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Nursing home residents have become monetized targets of real estate acquisitions. Established in 1960, Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs) were envisioned as allowing individuals to invest in commercial real estate without owning properties. That seemingly innocuous investment idea has led to the growth of a behind-the-scenes empire of little-understood conglomerates of REITs buying up nursing homes and other healthcare facilities across the country. Capitalizing on tax-exempt income incentives, exploiting “triple-net” leasebacks, funneling profits through subsidiaries, and shielding ownership and assets from the liability of operations, the corporatized owners extract cash from facilities and leave harm in their wake. And to grow the extractive operations, individuals and corporations can often invest in REITs on the stock market, lured with dividends siphoned from the “silver tsunami” of aging humans.

REITs are not alone, as private equity (PE) firms of every size have also set their sights on nursing homes. Further, local government hospital systems in multiple states are now mimicking private profiteering by similarly buying up nursing homes, not to improve care, but to take their Medicaid funds for other uses. The acquisition strategies of REITs, PE firms, and county hospital systems vary in structure, but they all share a common commodification need: bodies in the beds—maximizing occupancy rates while minimizing money spent on care—to increase the cash siphoned away.

This Article maps the maze of parasitic nursing home acquisition, revenue strategies, and resulting concerns, concluding with a call to curtail the practices—to convert the harm into care.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了REITs、私募股权公司和地方政府医院系统如何通过收购养老院，将老年人作为货币化目标，利用税收优惠、三净租赁等金融工具抽取资金，同时牺牲护理质量，最终呼吁遏制这些寄生性收购行为。
AI.research_question: REITs、私募股权公司和地方政府医院系统是如何通过收购养老院来实现利润抽取的？这些收购策略对养老院护理质量产生了哪些影响？
AI.motivation: 养老院居民已成为房地产收购的货币化目标，但公众对这些幕后收购帝国及其运作机制知之甚少，需要揭示其寄生性商业模式及其危害。
AI.theoretical_framework: 商品化理论（将老年人身体商品化）、寄生性收购理论、REITs与三净租赁的金融机制、私募股权逐利逻辑
AI.method: 法律与政策分析，结合案例研究，梳理REITs、PE和医院系统的收购结构与收入策略
AI.findings: REITs利用税收豁免和三净租赁抽取利润；PE公司以类似方式逐利；地方政府医院系统模仿私营模式，挪用养老院Medicaid资金。三者虽结构不同，但共同逻辑是最大化入住率、最小化护理支出，将老年人身体商品化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"寄生性收购"概念，将REITs、PE与公共医院系统的行为统一在商品化框架下分析，拓展了对养老院金融化剥削的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁政策制定者遏制这些寄生性收购行为，将伤害转化为真正的照护，为养老院监管改革提供依据。

title: The role of educational interventions in eliminating knowledge barriers to energy efficiency in young people: Evidence from a Randomized Controlled Trial (RCT) in Nepal
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and ETH Zürich - CER-ETH - Center of Economic Research at ETH Zurich

detail.title: The role of educational interventions in eliminating knowledge barriers to energy efficiency in young people: Evidence from a Randomized Controlled Trial (RCT) in Nepal
detail.abstract: In this study, we evaluate the impact of a short classroom-based educational intervention designed to improve financial literacy, energy-related financial literacy, and sustainability literacy among high school students in Nepal. The analysis is based on the primary data obtained from a randomized controlled trial (RCT) with 1,320 high school students in Kathmandu. The results reveal significant effects of the treatment leading to substantial improvement (short-run) in combined literacy scores (sum of energy-related financial literacy and sustainability literacy) by 7.86 points (175% increase), application skills by 1.73 points (89%), and the probability of choosing an energy-efficient motorbike in a hypothetical scenario increased by 24.7 percentage points (65%). Mediation analysis, used to examine potential channels of impact, indicates that 73% of the choice of the energy-efficient motorbike is driven by improved computational skills. These results provide robust evidence that brief educational interventions can effectively close knowledge barriers and potentially narrow intention-behavior gaps. These insights offer an avenue for further research and policy instigation to promote energy-efficient consumption in developing countries.

AI.tldr: 本文通过随机对照试验，评估了尼泊尔高中生的短期课堂金融与可持续素养教育干预的效果，发现干预显著提升了学生的综合素养分数、应用技能以及选择节能摩托车的概率，其中73%的节能选择由计算技能改善驱动。
AI.research_question: 短期课堂教育干预是否能有效提升尼泊尔高中生的金融素养、能源相关金融素养和可持续素养，并影响其能源效率消费选择？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家能源效率消费存在巨大的意愿-行为差距，但针对青少年的短期教育干预能否有效弥补知识障碍尚缺乏实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 素养经济学、行为经济学中的知识-行为差距理论、中介效应模型。
AI.method: 随机对照试验（RCT），样本量1,320名尼泊尔加德满都高中生；采用中介效应分析检验影响机制。
AI.findings: 干预使综合素养分数提升7.86分（增幅175%），应用技能提升1.73分（89%），选择节能摩托车的概率提高24.7个百分点（65%）；其中73%的节能选择效应由计算技能改善中介。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了短期教育干预可有效弥合知识-行为差距的因果证据，揭示计算技能是影响节能选择的关键中介机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家通过低成本短期教育项目促进能源效率消费提供了政策依据，具有可推广性和实操价值。

reference: Central Bank of Malta Research Paper Series No. 06/2026
title: An Updated Estimate of the Size of Malta's Underground Economy
affiliations: Central Bank of Malta

detail.title: An Updated Estimate of the Size of Malta's Underground Economy

publicationDetails.detailsText: Central Bank of Malta Research Paper Series No. 06/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: Central Bank of Malta Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The underground, or shadow, economy – comprising legal and productive activities concealed from authorities for monetary, regulatory, or institutional reasons – poses challenges to fiscal governance, labour protection, and market competition. This paper provides an updated estimate of the size of Malta’s underground economy over the period 1995–2024, employing a Multiple Indicators and Multiple Causes (MIMIC) model estimated on quarterly data. The specification includes four causal variables (tax burden, government expenditure, self-employment, and unemployment) and three indicators (currency-to-GDP ratio, real GDP growth, and labour force participation). All variables except government expenditure are statistically significant and display the expected signs. Increases in the tax burden, self-employment, and unemployment are associated with higher shadow-economy activity. The estimated trajectory of the shadow economy over the sample period suggests that the underground economy’s share of GDP rose modestly until 2009 and declined thereafter, reaching 15.3% in 2024. The findings are robust to alternative specifications and consistent with the empirical tendency for informality to decline with economic growth, as well as with increased institutional capacity focused on reducing tax evasion and other aspects of the informal economy in Malta.

AI.tldr: 本文利用MIMIC模型估计了马耳他1995-2024年地下经济规模，发现其占GDP比重在2009年前小幅上升，随后下降至2024年的15.3%。税收负担、自我雇佣和失业率是显著驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 马耳他地下经济在1995-2024年期间的规模有多大？其时间演变趋势如何？
AI.motivation: 地下经济对财政治理、劳动保护和市场竞争构成挑战，而现有对马耳他地下经济的估算可能过时，需要更新估计。
AI.theoretical_framework: MIMIC模型（多指标多原因模型），基于税收负担、政府支出、自我雇佣、失业率等因果变量与货币-GDP比率、实际GDP增长、劳动参与率等指标变量的关系。
AI.method: 采用MIMIC模型，基于1995-2024年季度数据进行估算。包含4个因果变量（税收负担、政府支出、自我雇佣、失业率）和3个指标变量（货币-GDP比率、实际GDP增长、劳动参与率）。
AI.findings: 除政府支出外，所有变量均统计显著且符号符合预期。税收负担、自我雇佣和失业率上升与地下经济增加相关。地下经济占GDP比重在2009年前小幅上升，随后下降，2024年达到15.3%。结果对替代设定稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 更新了马耳他地下经济的长期时序估计，验证了MIMIC模型在小国经济中的适用性，确认了经济增长与正规化之间的负相关关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为马耳他政策制定者提供了地下经济的量化基准，指出降低税收负担、减少失业和控制自我雇佣领域的非正规化是抑制地下经济的有效途径；肯定了马耳他近年来增强机构能力、打击逃税的努力成效。

title: Persistent Spatial Inequalities in Contraceptive Use in Nigeria: A Bayesian Spatio-Temporal model Evidence from Demographic Health Survey Data from 2003 to 2024
affiliations: University of Abuja, University of Abuja and University of Abuja

detail.title: Persistent Spatial Inequalities in Contraceptive Use in Nigeria: A Bayesian Spatio-Temporal model Evidence from Demographic Health Survey Data from 2003 to 2024

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received from anywhere.

detail.abstract:
Introduction: Contraceptive use remains unevenly distributed across Nigeria despite ongoing reproductive health interventions. This study assessed the spatio-temporal distribution and determinants of contraceptive use among women of reproductive age in Nigeria.

Methods: Data from the 2003, 2008, 2013, 2018, and 2024 Nigeria Demographic and Health Surveys involving 127,865 women aged 15-49 years were analyzed. Bayesian spatio-temporal conditional autoregressive models were fitted using the Integrated Nested Laplace Approximation (INLA) approach. Spatial, temporal, and nonlinear effects were modeled, and posterior exceedance probabilities were estimated.

Results: Overall prevalence of contraceptive use increased from 14.5% in 2003 to 20.7% in 2024, with a pooled prevalence of 16.0%. Contraceptive use was significantly associated with education ([[EQUATION]] = 13192.019, p<0.001) also wealth index, residence, marital status, and region were all significantly associated with increase prevalence of contraceptive use. Women with higher education had over four times higher odds of contraceptive use (OR = 4.10; 95%CI: 3.79-4.43), while women from the richest households had significantly higher odds of use (OR = 2.78; 95% CI: 2.55-3.03). Significant spatial heterogeneity persisted across states (σ=0.54), with southern states showing higher exceedance probabilities of contraceptive prevalence above the national average.

Conclusion: Although contraceptive use improved over time, substantial spatial and socioeconomic inequalities remain across Nigeria. Targeted reproductive health interventions should prioritize underserved northern and rural communities to reduce persistent disparities in contraceptive use.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2003-2024年五轮尼日利亚人口与健康调查数据，通过贝叶斯时空条件自回归模型分析，发现尼日利亚育龄妇女避孕使用率从14.5%缓慢上升至20.7%，但存在显著的空间异质性和社会经济不平等。教育水平、财富指数、居住地、婚姻状况和地区均显著影响避孕使用，南部各州避孕率高于全国平均水平，而北部和农村地区仍为薄弱环节。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚育龄妇女避孕使用的时空分布特征及其决定因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管尼日利亚持续开展生殖健康干预，但避孕使用率分布仍然不均，亟需从时空视角系统评估其分布格局和影响因素，以指导精准干预。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯时空统计模型方法，基于条件自回归（CAR）先验的时空建模框架。
AI.method: 采用贝叶斯时空条件自回归模型，通过集成嵌套拉普拉斯近似（INLA）方法进行拟合。数据来源为2003、2008、2013、2018和2024年五轮尼日利亚人口与健康调查，共包含127,865名15-49岁女性。
AI.findings: 避孕使用率从2003年的14.5%增至2024年的20.7%，合并患病率为16.0%。教育（OR=4.10）、财富（OR=2.78）、居住地、婚姻状况和地区均显著相关。各州间存在显著空间异质性（σ=0.54），南部各州超过全国平均水平的概率更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统运用贝叶斯时空模型揭示尼日利亚避孕使用率的长期时空动态格局，为全球生殖健康研究提供了发展中国家避孕行为时空异质性的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 明确了尼日利亚北部和农村地区为避孕干预的重点区域，建议针对性地优先在这些薄弱地区加强生殖健康服务，以缩小持续存在的地理和社会经济差距。

title: Workers' Empowerment as U.S. Trade Policy
affiliations: University of Georgia School of Law

detail.title: Workers' Empowerment as U.S. Trade Policy

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Georgia School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Georgia School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: U.S. trade policy stands at a critical inflection point. While the Biden administration’s “worker-centered” approach and the Trump administration’s “America First” platform sharply diverge, both recognize that trade deeply impacts domestic employment. However, both policies overlook how the treatment and costs of labor in partner nations directly protect U.S. workers from unfair competition. This Article argues that empowering foreign trade-sector workers to secure higher wages and better conditions must become a central pillar of U.S. trade policy. Drawing on an original empirical study of Mexico’s automotive sector under the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA), I demonstrate that recent "worker-centered" efforts failed to truly empower foreign labor. Instead, they left workers vulnerable, incentivized corporate offshoring, and suppressed foreign consumer power—deficiencies that ultimately harmed domestic workers and fueled protectionist, tariff-driven alternatives. By uncovering the direct link between foreign supply-chain capacity and U.S. job opportunities, this Article challenges conventional narratives surrounding trade agreements and foreign aid. Ultimately, it underscores the urgent need to radically reconceptualize U.S. trade policy to protect the global workers who make trade possible.

AI.tldr: 本文论证美国贸易政策应赋予外国贸易部门工人更高工资和更好条件以保护本国工人，通过研究美墨加协定下墨西哥汽车行业发现，现有"以工人为中心"政策未能真正赋能外国劳工，反而损害了美国工人利益并助长保护主义。
AI.research_question: 美国贸易政策如何通过保护外国贸易部门工人的权益来维护美国国内工人的利益？
AI.motivation: 两届美国政府（拜登的"以工人为中心"与特朗普的"美国优先"）虽都认识到贸易影响国内就业，但都忽视了合作伙伴国家劳工待遇与美国工人保护之间的直接联系，现有政策反而损害了美国工人利益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易与劳工权益关联理论；全球供应链能力与国内就业机会的直接联系理论；贸易协定与外国援助的批判性叙事。
AI.method: 原创实证研究，以美墨加协定下墨西哥汽车行业为案例。
AI.findings: 现有"以工人为中心"政策未能真正赋能外国劳工，反而使工人更脆弱、激励企业离岸外包、压制外国消费能力，最终损害国内工人并助长关税保护主义。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了外国供应链能力与美国就业机会之间的直接因果关联，挑战了关于贸易协定和外国援助的传统叙事。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国贸易政策提供了根本性的重新构想方向，强调必须保护使贸易成为可能的全球工人。

title:
The Monk Who Generated $280 Million by Capturing Nothing

Value Without Capture in the Age of Institutional Distrust
affiliations: Independent

detail.title:
The Monk Who Generated $280 Million by Capturing Nothing

Value Without Capture in the Age of Institutional Distrust

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded

detail.abstract:
Thích Minh Tuệ, a Vietnamese ascetic practitioner, holds no institution, no bank account, no fundraising apparatus, no media operation, and no monetization channel. His personal economic capture is approximately zero. Yet the activity surrounding his transnational pilgrimage is associated with an estimated US$117M–US$499M in annual distributed economic circulation, with a central estimate of US$280M and PPP-adjusted effects above US$1 billion.

A nine-layer analytical framework decomposes these flows across pilgrimage mobility, digital creator ecosystems, informal dāna networks, diaspora remittances, local commerce, symbolic goods, tourism spillovers, and community redistribution. Four independent data streams test the estimate. 

First, reported charitable disbursements by the Vietnam Buddhist Sangha (VBS) contracted 39%, from US$135M in 2024 to US$82.3M in 2025, against a total VBS revenue base of US$257M–US$263M; applying plausible disbursement ratios of 10–20% to the documented 39% year-on-year contraction implies a total institutional contribution withdrawal of US$263M–US$527M within a single year (VietnamPlus, 2026; Buddhistdoor Global, 2026) — a range equivalent to 94%–188% of the nine-layer model's central estimate, with the midpoint at roughly 141%. 

Second, alternative charitable channels expanded over the same period, with roughly US$1.09B mobilized through the Vietnam Fatherland Front. 

Third, Vietnam received approximately US$18B in overseas remittances in 2025; within that reservoir, household-survey evidence places the community-and-social channel at 5–12% of inflows, or US$900M–US$2.2B annually — a carrier of sufficient scale to absorb the diaspora-routed share of the nine-layer estimate. 

Fourth, the behavioral shift underlying these flows was documented qualitatively before it was measured econometrically: Buddhistdoor Global ran a September 2024 feature, Thích Minh Tuệ: A Therapist for a Wounded Society, reporting behavioral changes already observed across spring and early summer 2024, and causal machine learning evidence from Michigan State University (Nguyen et al., 2024) subsequently quantified the same shifts as measurable behavioral effects of exposure to the phenomenon. The four streams converge on the same order of magnitude without coordination or shared inputs, and point to redistribution rather than contraction in aggregate generosity.

The case complicates a standard assumption in institutional economics — that value creation requires ownership, organizational coordination, or capture. Here, sustained non-capture appears to be the generative condition: prolonged public observation produces credibility, credibility produces trust, and trust reorganizes resource flows around the observed practice without routing them through any institution the practitioner controls.

The paper develops the concept of distributed credibility systems: legitimacy formed through prolonged public observation rather than institutional accreditation. Under such conditions, economic activity can organize around perceived authenticity in the absence of formal structure. Implications are drawn for religion and economics, informal institutions, diaspora capital flows, digital attention economies, and the formation of non-market value when moral authority and institutional distrust move in opposite directions.

AI.tldr: 本文以越南苦行僧Thích Minh Tuệ为例，发现其个人近乎零经济捕获，但围绕其跨国朝圣产生的年度分布式经济流通高达2.8亿美元（购买力平价调整后超10亿美元）。论文提出"分布式可信系统"概念，认为在无机构背书、无所有权、无组织协调的条件下，持续公开观察本身可生成合法性、信任，并重构资源流动。四组独立数据交叉验证了这一量级，挑战了制度经济学中"价值创造需要所有权或组织捕获"的核心假设。
AI.research_question: 在无所有权、无组织协调、无经济捕获的情况下，价值如何被创造并形成大规模经济流通？
AI.motivation: Thích Minh Tuệ现象提供了一个极端案例：个人近乎零经济收益，却引发了数亿美元的社会经济循环。这挑战了制度经济学关于"所有权/机构/组织是价值创造必要条件"的基本假设，促使作者探究非捕获状态下的价值生成机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度经济学（关于所有权、组织协调与价值创造的标准假设）；分布式可信系统理论（合法性通过持续公开观察而非制度认证形成）；社会资本与信任理论；非市场价值形成机制。
AI.method: 九层分析框架分解经济流（朝圣流动性、数字创作者生态、非正式布施网络、侨汇、地方商业、象征性商品、旅游溢出、社区再分配）；四组独立数据源交叉验证（越南佛教僧团慈善支出收缩、越南祖国阵线替代性慈善渠道、海外侨汇中社区社会渠道占比、密歇根州立大学因果机器学习证据+定性行为报道）。
AI.findings: （1）年度分布式经济流通中心估计为2.8亿美元，PPP调整后超10亿美元；（2）越南佛教僧团慈善支出同比收缩39%，约2.63亿至5.27亿美元，与九层模型中心估计的141%吻合；（3）海外侨汇中社区社会渠道占5-12%（9亿至22亿美元），足以吸收侨汇部分；（4）因果机器学习证实接触该现象产生可测量的行为改变效应；（5）四组数据独立收敛于同一量级，指向"再分配"而非"收缩"。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"分布式可信系统"概念，挑战了制度经济学中"价值创造需要所有权、组织协调或经济捕获"的核心假设，证明持续非捕获本身可以成为价值生成条件，为理解非市场价值、道德权威与制度不信任并存情境下的经济活动提供了新理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 对宗教经济、非正式制度、侨汇资本流动、数字注意力经济等领域提供实践启示；为理解在制度信任下降的环境中，基于公开观察的可信系统如何组织大规模资源流动提供了实证参考；对政策制定者理解非机构化社会运动的经济影响具有借鉴意义。

title: Search-Tracked Postcard Conversions in Japan: A Small 2 x 2 Field Test of Text Orientation and Handwritten Typeface
affiliations: Uzura Inc

detail.title: Search-Tracked Postcard Conversions in Japan: A Small 2 x 2 Field Test of Text Orientation and Handwritten Typeface

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The study concerns a marketing campaign. The author may have professional involvement with the campaign. No additional competing interests are declared.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper reports aggregate campaign-level counts only. It does not disclose personal data about recipients.
declarations.funderStatement: No external academic funding was reported for this working paper.

detail.abstract: This working paper reports a small local field test of Japanese postcard direct mail. Four postcard variants crossed text orientation (vertical versus horizontal) with typeface style (Gothic versus handwritten-style). Each condition was mailed to 1,000 recipients. Responses were tracked by assigning a different search keyword to each postcard and measuring subsequent search and landing-page conversions through Google Ads. Conversion counts were sparse: 1/1,000 for vertical/Gothic, 3/1,000 for vertical/handwrittenstyle, 4/1,000 for horizontal/Gothic, and 7/1,000 for horizontal/handwritten-style. The observed pattern is directionally consistent with a possible benefit from handwritten-style typography and, in this campaign, from horizontal layout. However, the evidence is not statistically significant under exact tests and should not be interpreted as causal proof. The main contribution is a transparent case note on an offline-to-online tracking method and on the practical interpretation of low-incidence field-test results in a Japanese local marketing context.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过实地测试日本明信片直邮广告，比较了文字方向（纵向 vs 横向）与字体风格（哥特体 vs 手写体）对转化效果的影响，发现手写体和横向布局可能带来更好的转化率，但统计上不显著，主要贡献在于透明地记录了低发生率实地测试的方法与解读。
AI.research_question: 日本明信片直邮广告中，文字方向（纵向 vs 横向）与字体风格（哥特体 vs 手写体）如何影响收件人的线上搜索及落地页转化行为？
AI.motivation: 直邮广告在日本营销中仍广泛使用，但关于其视觉设计元素（如文字方向、字体风格）对离线到在线追踪转化效果影响的实证证据匮乏，尤其是低发生率场景下的实地测试案例更为稀缺。
AI.theoretical_framework: 视觉设计心理学（排版与阅读方向影响认知负荷与信息加工）、线下到线上（O2O）追踪方法论（通过独立关键词归因转化）。
AI.method: 小型实地现场测试：4种明信片变体（2×2因子设计：纵向/横向 × 哥特体/手写体），每种条件邮寄1,000份；通过Google Ads分配不同搜索关键词追踪转化。
AI.findings: 转化率分别为：纵向/哥特体 0.1%、纵向/手写体 0.3%、横向/哥特体 0.4%、横向/手写体 0.7%。方向性表明手写体与横向布局可能有利，但精确检验下统计不显著，不能视为因果证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 为视觉设计与O2O营销的交叉领域提供了低发生率场景下的实地测试透明案例，补充了现有关于直邮设计效果研究的统计力度与可复制性讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为日本本地营销从业者提供了低转化率直邮测试的实操参考：包括通过独立关键词追踪O2O路径的方法、解读稀疏数据时应避免过度推断的警示，以及设计测试时需考虑统计效力问题。

detail.abstract:
This paper reports AIAS Presence Index v0.23, measuring AI Presence for 24 premium spirits brands across
six large language models under Protocol v1.6. Premium spirits is the seventh substrate family in the AIAS
measurement program and the first to exhibit a universal recognition ceiling: all 144 Phase A probes return
R3 (rich recognition), eliminating recognition variance from the composite entirely. The Presence distribu-
tion is driven exclusively by Recall — which brands AI systems recommend, not which they can describe.
Composite scores range from 40.0 (perfect recognition, zero recall) to 71.19, distributing evenly across four
regimes (6 Dominant, 6 Established, 6 Emerging, 6 Absent). Six brands that LLMs characterize in expert
detail — Bombay Sapphire, The Balvenie, Casamigos, Compass Box, Fernet-Branca, and Jameson — are
never or rarely surfaced in recommendation contexts, exposing a recognition–recall gap invisible to tra-
ditional brand-tracking methods. The substrate-specific hypothesis H_ConglomeratePortfolio is falsified:
conglomerate-owned brands (n = 14) average 60.75 on the Presence composite versus 58.05 for indepen-
dents (n = 10), a non-significant 4.6% lift (t = 0.59, p = 0.28). The two-channel recall architecture (editorial-
authority, cultural-cult) yields an overlap coefficient of 0.80, the highest across seven substrates, indicating
channel convergence in high-familiarity categories. Pre-registration, data, and scoring code are deposited
at OSF (osf.io/ec6wh/v23/).

title: Gasoline Price Shocks and Consumer Spending: Evidence from Household Purchases

detail.title: Gasoline Price Shocks and Consumer Spending: Evidence from Household Purchases

publicationDetails.detailsText: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Series

detail.abstract: I study the effect of gasoline price shocks on consumer spending. I leverage large, exogenous, and temporary price shocks that affected California but not other states to estimate event studies and treatment effects in a difference-indifferences framework. During event weeks, California households cut retail spending by about 8 percent relative to comparison states, with similarly sized declines in food expenditures and smaller, noisier responses in non-food expenditures. The spending path mirrors the price path-falling within weeks of the price shock and reverting slowly as prices ease. Heterogeneity by income quartile shows that these spending reductions are larger for lower income households and more muted for higher income households. The results show that shortlived, highly visible fuel price shocks can generate sizable reductions in household spending, mostly driven by reductions in retail food categories such as generic grocery, meat, frozen food, and bakery, with smaller and less significant effects on produce and dairy.

AI.tldr: 本文利用加州特有的、外生且暂时的汽油价格冲击，通过双重差分和事件研究法发现，汽油价格冲击导致加州家庭零售支出下降约8%，低收入家庭受影响更大，支出减少主要集中在食品零售类别。
AI.research_question: 汽油价格冲击如何影响消费者支出？不同收入群体的消费反应是否存在异质性？
AI.motivation: 汽油价格波动频繁且影响广泛，但已有研究对短期、大幅的价格冲击如何影响家庭消费行为的因果识别不足，尤其是缺乏利用外生冲击进行准实验设计的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费行为理论、价格弹性理论、收入效应与替代效应、异质性消费者理论
AI.method: 利用加州特有的外生、暂时性汽油价格冲击，采用双重差分（DID）框架与事件研究法，将加州与其他州进行比较，估计处理效应。
AI.findings: （1）汽油价格冲击期间，加州家庭零售支出比对照州下降约8%；（2）食品支出下降幅度类似，非食品支出反应较小且统计上不够显著；（3）支出变化路径与价格路径基本一致，冲击后数周内下降，随价格回落缓慢恢复；（4）低收入家庭支出降幅更大，高收入家庭反应更温和；（5）支出减少主要由零售食品类别（如杂货、肉类、冷冻食品、烘焙食品）驱动，农产品和乳制品影响较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 为短期、高频汽油价格冲击对消费支出的因果效应提供了干净识别证据，揭示了价格冲击传导至消费的时滞与恢复模式，丰富了能源价格与消费行为关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解汽油税、碳定价等能源价格政策对家庭消费（尤其是低收入家庭）的短期影响提供实证依据；为零售商和供应链管理者预测价格冲击下的消费变化提供参考。

title: Competitiveness, Productivity, and Efficiency of Farmers’ Cooperatives: Evidence from the Polish Dairy Industry
affiliations: Warsaw University of Life Sciences, Warsaw University of Life Sciences and Warsaw University of Life Sciences

detail.title: Competitiveness, Productivity, and Efficiency of Farmers’ Cooperatives: Evidence from the Polish Dairy Industry
detail.abstract: Cooperatives are key players in the dairy sector both globally and in Poland. Increasing pressure on the economic performance of dairy cooperatives poses questions about the drivers that shape their competitiveness. The aim of the paper is twofold. Firstly, the paper assesses the productivity and efficiency of dairy cooperatives and how these features evolved over time. Secondly, it examines whether and to what extent productivity and efficiency determine the competitiveness of entities under the study. As an empirical illustration, the authors use a dataset on dairy cooperatives operating in Poland, which is an important producer of dairy products in the European Union (EU). The results (obtained using partial productivity and data envelopment analysis) confirm that productivity and efficiency affect the competitiveness of dairy cooperatives. However, a primary contribution is to demonstrate that the relationship between productivity and efficiency versus competitiveness is more complex. Taking into account factors like the qualitative features of market offerings and their influence on consumer behaviur and satisfaction is essential for a thorough assessment of the competitiveness of dairy cooperatives.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了波兰乳制品合作社的生产率与效率如何影响其竞争力。结果表明，虽然生产率和效率确实影响竞争力，但二者之间的关系比预期更为复杂，需结合市场供给的定性特征和消费者行为等因素进行综合评估。
AI.research_question: 乳制品合作社的生产率和效率如何随时间演变？生产率和效率在多大程度上决定了乳制品合作社的竞争力？
AI.motivation: 乳制品合作社在全球及波兰乳制品行业中扮演关键角色，但其经济绩效面临日益增长的压力，亟需探究驱动竞争力的因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生产率与效率理论；竞争力评估框架；消费者行为与市场供给定性特征相关理论。
AI.method: 使用波兰乳制品合作社数据，采用部分生产率分析（Partial Productivity）和数据包络分析（DEA）进行实证研究。
AI.findings: 生产率和效率确实影响乳制品合作社的竞争力，但二者与竞争力的关系较为复杂；仅关注生产率和效率不足以全面评估竞争力，还需纳入市场供给的定性特征、消费者行为及满意度等因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了生产率与效率同竞争力之间关系的复杂性，挑战了二者简单线性关联的传统观点，为竞争力理论提供了更细致的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为乳制品合作社及类似农业合作组织提供了竞争力提升的综合评估框架，提示管理者在关注运营效率的同时，需重视产品质量、消费者满意度等定性因素。

title: The Hollow Middle: AI-Driven Restructuring of Professional Sectors, Governance Gaps, and the Pipeline Crisis
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Hollow Middle: AI-Driven Restructuring of Professional Sectors, Governance Gaps, and the Pipeline Crisis
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is no longer a horizon-level disruption in professional services. It is an active, present-tense force reshaping how knowledge work is completed, which roles command premium value, and which institutions are gaining or losing competitive ground. This article synthesizes current peer-reviewed research and regulatory developments to assess AI's structural impact across professional sectors, with particular attention to three underappreciated dynamics: the growing gap between AI operational deployment and governance readiness; the early-career employment contraction that threatens long-term talent pipelines; and the emergence of sectorspecific regulatory obligations that are driving immediate compliance demand. Drawing on empirical evidence from the Stanford Digital Economy Lab, Harvard Business School, the World Economic Forum, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, and the IBM Institute for Business Value, the analysis identifies where near-term advisory and governance intervention is most warranted and what organizations need to do about it.

AI.tldr: 本文综合最新同行评审研究及监管动态，评估人工智能对专业服务领域的结构性影响，重点关注三大被低估的趋势：AI运营部署与治理准备之间的差距、早期职业岗位收缩对人才管道构成的威胁、以及行业特定监管义务带来的合规需求激增。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何重塑专业服务领域的结构性竞争格局？哪些被低估的动态正在改变知识工作的价值分配？
AI.motivation: AI在专业服务领域已不再是未来的颠覆性力量，而是当下的现实。然而，学术界和实务界对AI的结构性影响仍存在认知盲区，尤其是运营部署与治理之间的鸿沟、人才管道断裂风险以及行业监管合规压力等尚未被充分关注的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于实证数据综合分析方法，整合斯坦福数字经济实验室、哈佛商学院、世界经济论坛、美国劳工统计局及IBM商业价值研究院的多源证据。
AI.method: 文献综述与实证数据分析相结合，对现有同行评审研究和监管发展进行系统整合。
AI.findings: 识别出三大关键动态：(1) AI部署速度远超治理准备，形成显著差距；(2) 早期职业岗位缩减威胁长期人才供应链；(3) 行业特定监管义务催生即时合规需求，需优先进行咨询与治理干预。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地揭示了AI在专业服务领域中三个被低估的结构性动态，为未来AI治理研究提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了明确的近期行动指南，指出在咨询和治理干预方面最需要优先投入的领域，帮助管理者识别竞争格局变化并制定应对策略。

title: Fiduciary Infrastructure for Agentic AI: Directors' Duties and Investor Protection in the EU, South Korea and Singapore
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS) - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Fiduciary Infrastructure for Agentic AI: Directors' Duties and Investor Protection in the EU, South Korea and Singapore

keywords: Singapore Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI

detail.abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence-autonomous systems that plan across multiple steps and act in dynamic environments without human direction-has begun to be integrated in a material way into the operations of companies around the world. Its deployment highlights the limits of the classical principal-agent framework on which modern corporate law rests: agentic AI systems are not utility maximisers, their internal reasoning is not readily seen nor reliably verifiable, and they fall outside the legal and economic categories through which agency doctrine allocates responsibility. This paper argues that directors' fiduciary obligations in respect of agentic AI are best understood through what the paper terms the fiduciary infrastructure: a four-layer account (data, model, deployment, accountability) of the duty of care that directors now owe to their companies in the adoption of agentic AI in their operations. The term is developed through a comparative study of three jurisdictions whose AI governance frameworks together occupy the spectrum of regulatory responses available to advanced economies-the prescriptive EU AI Act, the hybrid Korean AI Basic Act, and Singapore's voluntary Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI-and is anchored in existing corporate-law authorities: Vita Health and Goh Jin Hian in Singapore, Siemens/Neubürger in Germany as representative Member State, and the Daewoo line in South Korea. The paper extends the analysis to investor protection, identifying three distinct enforcement architectures and the novel information asymmetries that agentic AI generates for capital markets, and proposes targeted reforms in corporate law and securities disclosure.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了生成式人工智能（代理型AI）对企业法律中委托-代理框架的挑战，提出"受托基础设施"四层模型（数据、模型、部署、问责），并通过欧盟、韩国、新加坡三地比较研究与相关公司法判例，论证董事在采用代理型AI时的受信义务，进而延伸至投资者保护与资本市场监管改革。
AI.research_question: 在代理型AI被企业广泛采用的背景下，董事对公司的受信义务（特别是注意义务）应如何被重新理解和界定？
AI.motivation: 代理型AI（可自主多步规划并在动态环境中行动的系统）正在实质性融入全球企业运营，但其特性（非效用最大化、内部推理难以验证、无法被传统法律与经济范畴归类）严重挑战了现代公司法赖以存在的经典委托-代理框架，亟需新的理论解释和监管回应。
AI.theoretical_framework: "受托基础设施"（fiduciary infrastructure）四层模型：数据层、模型层、部署层、问责层；以董事注意义务为核心，结合代理理论、公司法受托义务学说与AI治理框架。
AI.method: 比较研究法：分析三个法域（欧盟《AI法案》的硬性监管路径、韩国的混合模式、新加坡的自愿治理框架）的AI治理框架；结合现有公司法判例（新加坡Vita Health与Goh Jin Hian案、德国Siemens/Neubürger案、韩国Daewoo系列案）进行法律分析。
AI.findings: 1. 代理型AI突破了传统委托-代理框架的三大核心假设（效用最大化、可验证推理、可归责性）；2. 董事的注意义务应通过"受托基础设施"四层模型加以理解和执行；3. 不同法域的AI监管路径存在显著差异，但均需在现有公司法框架内加以整合；4. 代理型AI在资本市场上产生了新型信息不对称，需要针对性的公司法和证券披露改革。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"受托基础设施"概念，将AI治理分层与董事受信义务有机结合，为公司法如何在AI时代适应技术变革提供了系统的理论框架；填补了代理型AI对经典委托-代理理论挑战的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业董事会采用代理型AI提供了可操作的注意义务指引（数据、模型、部署、问责四层）；为监管者提供了不同法域AI治理路径的比较参考；提出投资者保护的三类执行架构及资本市场监管改革建议。

title: AI as a Generative Pathway System: How Generative AI Reshapes Possibility, Continuation, and Human Agency

detail.title: AI as a Generative Pathway System: How Generative AI Reshapes Possibility, Continuation, and Human Agency

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental interventions and therefore did not require institutional ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding support.

detail.abstract: Generative AI is often understood as an output-centered system that produces answers, drafts, plans, or recommendations. This paper argues that this view is useful but incomplete. In sustained, inquiry-led interaction, generative AI can also shape whether possibilities persist, develop, branch, shift direction, or close. The paper introduces AI as a Generative Pathway System, a conceptual model of pathway formation built around two mechanisms: Premature Closure Reduction and Continuation Scaffolding. Rather than treating continuation as inherently beneficial, the model positions Relational Integrity and Human Agency as governing conditions for responsible continuation. Drawing on path dependence, cognitive load theory, scaffolding, choice architecture, exploration–exploitation dynamics, and research on human–AI interaction, the paper develops a conceptual framework for examining how generative AI shapes the survival, direction, and governance of possibilities over time across individual, institutional, and collective contexts. The model’s central claim is that responsible pathway formation depends on mechanisms for opening and extending possibilities together with governing conditions that guide judgments about when continuation should be sustained, redirected, or responsibly discontinued.

AI.tldr: 本文提出生成式AI不仅是输出中心化的系统，更是一个“生成性路径系统”（Generative Pathway System），通过“过早闭合减少”与“持续支架”两种机制，塑造可能性的存续、发展、分支、转向或关闭，并强调“关系完整性”与“人类能动性”作为负责任延续的治理条件。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI如何作为一种路径塑造系统，影响可能性（possibilities）的存续、方向与治理？
AI.motivation: 现有研究过度强调生成式AI的输出中心视角（产出答案、草案、计划等），忽视了其在持续、探究驱动的互动中如何塑造可能性路径的形成、分支与关闭。
AI.theoretical_framework: 路径依赖（Path Dependence）、认知负荷理论（Cognitive Load Theory）、支架理论（Scaffolding）、选择架构（Choice Architecture）、探索-利用动力学（Exploration–Exploitation Dynamics）、人-AI交互研究。
AI.method: 概念模型构建与理论整合，提出AI作为生成性路径系统（Generative Pathway System）的概念框架。
AI.findings: 1）生成式AI通过“过早闭合减少”和“持续支架”两种机制塑造路径形成；2）连续延续并非天然有益，需以“关系完整性”和“人类能动性”作为治理条件；3）负责任路径形成需要同时具备打开/扩展可能性的机制与判断何时延续、转向或终止的治理条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了“生成性路径系统”这一新概念模型，将生成式AI从输出中心视角拓展为路径塑造视角，并引入“关系完整性”与“人类能动性”作为负责任延续的治理条件，丰富了人-AI交互与路径依赖理论的对话。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI系统设计者、政策制定者及用户提供了如何判断AI驱动路径何时应持续、转向或终止的分析框架，支持在个体、机构与集体层面负责任地管理AI引导的可能性空间。

title: 일본의 노동력 부족 대응 전략과 시사점(Labor Shortages in Japan: Policy Responses and Implications)
affiliations: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy and Korea Institute for International Economic Policy

detail.title: 일본의 노동력 부족 대응 전략과 시사점(Labor Shortages in Japan: Policy Responses and Implications)

publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study examines Japan’s labor shortage, tracing it from cyclical tightness in the early 1970s and the late-1980s/early-1990s bubble to a structural shortfall since the mid-2010s driven by the sustained contraction of the working-age population. Earlier episodes were demand-led and policy-induced (for example, the transition to a 40-hour work week), whereas today’s tightness is demographic in origin and therefore persistent. Chapter 2 details these dynamics and the underlying structural constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文追溯日本劳动力短缺从20世纪70年代初和80年代末/90年代初的周期性紧缩，到2010年代中期以来由劳动年龄人口持续减少驱动的结构性短缺的演变过程。
AI.research_question: 日本劳动力短缺的性质如何从周期性演变为结构性？当前人口驱动的紧缩与过往政策/需求驱动的紧缩有何不同？
AI.motivation: 理解日本劳动力短缺的演变模式，区分周期性紧缩与结构性短缺，以更好地应对持续的人口挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场周期性紧缩理论；人口结构与劳动力供给关系理论；结构性劳动力短缺理论。
AI.method: 历史分析/纵向研究——通过时间序列对比不同时期的劳动力短缺特征（1970年代、80年代末/90年代初、2010年代中期至今）。
AI.findings: 早期劳动力短缺是需求驱动和政策诱导的（如向每周40小时工作制过渡），而当前短缺是人口结构性的、持续性的，源于劳动年龄人口的持续萎缩。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了"需求/政策驱动型"与"人口结构驱动型"两种劳动力短缺性质，为劳动力市场周期性-结构性分析提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为日本及面临类似人口挑战的国家提供政策启示：人口结构性短缺无法通过传统需求刺激或政策调整解决，需要针对人口问题的长期应对策略。

title: Vertical Integration in a Consumer Packaged Goods Industry: Impacts on Product Variety, Prices, and Consumer Welfare

detail.title: Vertical Integration in a Consumer Packaged Goods Industry: Impacts on Product Variety, Prices, and Consumer Welfare
detail.abstract: This paper examines how vertical integration affects product variety, prices, and consumer welfare in a major consumer packaged goods sector. The analysis focuses on firms that consolidated upstream and downstream operations during the study period. Using a difference-indifferences strategy that exploits quasi-experimental variation across regional markets and a structural demand estimation, I quantify welfare effects and, through supply-side analysis, decompose price changes into cost and markup components. Vertical integration led to substantial product variety expansion and moderate price reductions. Consumer welfare increased substantially, roughly 10-15% of average category expenditures. Welfare decomposition indicates that about two-thirds of these gains stem from lower prices, with the remainder from increased variety. These findings demonstrate that vertical integration can improve consumer welfare through both price and non-price channels, highlighting the importance of incorporating product variety into antitrust analysis alongside traditional price effects. * Researcher(s)' own analyses calculated (or derived) based in part on data from Nielsen Consumer LLC and marketing databases provided through the NielsenIQ Datasets at the Kilts Center for Marketing Data Center at The University of Chicago Booth School of Business. The conclusions drawn from the NielsenIQ data are those of the researcher(s) and do not reflect the views of NielsenIQ. NielsenIQ is not responsible for, had no role in, and was not involved in analyzing and preparing the results reported herein. I am grateful for helpful feedback and guidance from Anthony Creane,

AI.tldr: 本文研究纵向整合对产品多样性、价格和消费者福利的影响，发现纵向整合显著扩大了产品种类并适度降低了价格，消费者福利提升约10-15%的平均类别支出，其中约三分之二来自价格下降，其余来自品种增加。
AI.research_question: 纵向整合如何影响产品多样性、价格和消费者福利？
AI.motivation: 传统反垄断分析主要关注价格效应，忽视了产品多样性等非价格渠道的影响。作者试图弥补这一空白，全面评估纵向整合对消费者福利的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 纵向整合理论、产品多样性理论、消费者福利理论
AI.method: 双重差分法（利用跨区域市场的准实验变异）结合结构性需求估计，并通过供给侧分析将价格变化分解为成本和加成率成分。
AI.findings: 纵向整合导致产品种类大幅扩展，价格适度下降；消费者福利显著提高（约10-15%的平均类别支出）；福利分解显示约三分之二来自价格下降，其余来自品种增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了纵向整合能通过价格和非价格双重渠道改善消费者福利，强调反垄断分析应将产品多样性纳入考量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为反垄断监管机构提供了纵向整合福利效应的量化证据，提示在评估纵向合并时需关注产品种类变化这一重要维度。

title: The Fractional AI Officer Model: An Operator-side ROI Benchmark for SMB AI Implementation (2026)
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Fractional AI Officer Model: An Operator-side ROI Benchmark for SMB AI Implementation (2026)
detail.abstract: This paper introduces and quantifies the Fractional AI Officer model, a third-path engagement structure between full-time AI executive hire and vendor-license SaaS adoption for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) with annual revenue between USD 1 million and USD 50 million. The research question asks what return-on-investment (ROI) multiplier an embedded operator-side implementation generates compared with a traditional vendor-license model. Methodology consists of single-operator observational case studies across five businesses (B2B distribution, e-commerce, retail, education, AI consulting) over a 24-month window (April 2024 to April 2026). Measurement covers operator and employee hours saved, revenue captured that would otherwise be missed, SaaS or vendor spend avoided, headcount cost avoided, and time-to-value compared with traditional consulting engagement. Headline finding: across three documented case studies the operator-side model produces a 3.2 to 4.7 multiplier on revenue captured per dollar of AI stack cost, with a median of 3.9, against an estimated vendor-side baseline of 1.1 to 1.6. The model trades scale for embeddedness, with limitations including small sample, observational design, and founder-operator selection bias. The paper contributes a working definition of the Fractional AI Officer role, a measurement framework other researchers can replicate, and a three-step decision rubric (audit, sprint, install) for SMB operators evaluating AI deployment paths.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并量化了"兼职AI官（Fractional AI Officer）"模型——介于全职AI高管与供应商SaaS订阅之间的第三种中小企业AI部署路径。基于5家企业24个月的观察性案例研究，发现操作者嵌入模式的ROI乘数（中位数3.9）显著高于传统供应商模式（1.1-1.6）。
AI.research_question: 相对于传统的供应商授权模式，嵌入式的"操作者端"AI实施能够为中小企业带来多大的ROI乘数？
AI.motivation: 中小企业（年营收100万至5000万美元）在部署AI时面临两难：全职AI高管成本过高，纯SaaS供应商模式又缺乏嵌入深度。现有文献缺乏介于两者之间的"第三条路径"（Fractional AI Officer）的系统量化研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 未明确标注经典理论，但隐含着"嵌入性"（embeddedness）与"规模经济"之间的权衡逻辑，以及ROI乘数比较分析框架。
AI.method: 单操作者观察性案例研究，涉及5家企业（B2B分销、电商、零售、教育、AI咨询），时间跨度24个月（2024年4月至2026年4月）。测量指标包括：操作者与员工节省工时、捕获的原本会错失的收入、SaaS/供应商支出规避、人头成本规避、以及与传统咨询模式的到达价值时间对比。
AI.findings: 在三个已完成的案例研究中，操作者嵌入模型每投入1美元AI栈成本可捕获3.2至4.7倍收入（中位数3.9），而供应商模式的基线估算为1.1至1.6倍。模型以规模换取嵌入深度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了"兼职AI官（Fractional AI Officer）"的工作定义；建立了一个可复制的测量框架；提出了一个三步决策准则（审计-冲刺-安装），供中小企业运营者评估AI部署路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为年营收100万至5000万美元的中小企业提供了一条中间路径的量化证据，帮助其在全职聘用与纯供应商采购之间做出更优决策。三步决策准则（审计-冲刺-安装）具备可直接落地的操作指引价值。

title: Foresight-oriented Design to Inform the Future of Agriculture: Insights from an Australian Case Study
affiliations: , Government of the Commonwealth of Australia - CSIRO Health & Biosecurity and CSIRO

detail.title: Foresight-oriented Design to Inform the Future of Agriculture: Insights from an Australian Case Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This research was funded by the Ag2050 program, which was an internal investment by the CSIRO. This paper evaluates the efficacy of a foresight-oriented design process that was implemented to guide future research and development directions under this program and provides insights and recommendations for others working in agricultural innovation systems, strategic foresight, human-centred design, or the intersection of two or more of these fields. Due to the conditions stipulated in the ethics approval process, the dataset generated during the current study cannot be made available. Access to anonymised data may be considered by the corresponding author upon reasonable request and subject to institutional ethics committee approval.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research protocol was approved by CSIRO’s Social Science Human Research Ethics Committee in line with the guidelines specified in the National Statement on Ethical Conduct in Human Research. Due to the conditions stipulated in the ethics approval process, the dataset generated during the current study cannot be made available. Access to anonymised data may be considered by the corresponding author upon reasonable request and subject to institutional ethics committee approval.

detail.abstract: The emerging horizon for Australian agriculture is increasingly complex and uncertain, shaped by the interplay of economic, social, technological and environmental drivers. There is a growing acknowledgement of the value of systems-level and participatory approaches, such as human-centred design and strategic foresight, both of which form part of the solution to navigating this complexity and uncertainty. This paper suggests a 'foresight-oriented design' process, which combines the complementary strengths of each approach to support the exploration and identification of system-level, long-term and tangible solutions for future agricultural innovation systems in Australia. Our case study presents a pilot of this approach, in which a diverse cohort of scientists used a set of predefined future agricultural scenarios to rapidly and collaboratively design a solution to a future-focused agricultural innovation systems challenge. The integration between strategic foresight and human-centered design fills a gap in the literature while also meeting current needs of a more considered and coordinated response across different sectors. By shifting the conversations about predictable to plausible futures (via strategic foresight) and providing tangible guidance to stakeholders (via human-centred design), this approach may reduce the foresight-impact gap, improving the alignment and actionability of foresight insights. We discuss these findings in the context of broader developments in agricultural innovation systems literature and areas for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"前瞻导向设计"流程，将战略前瞻与以人为本的设计相结合，用于探索澳大利亚农业创新系统的长期可行解决方案。案例研究表明，该方法通过从"可预测"转向"可能"的未来讨论，并辅以具体指导，有助于缩小前瞻与实际影响之间的差距。
AI.research_question: 如何整合战略前瞻与以人为本的设计，以支持农业创新系统层面的长期且可行的解决方案探索？
AI.motivation: 澳大利亚农业面临经济、社会、技术和环境等多重驱动因素带来的复杂性与不确定性，现有方法缺乏系统层面和参与式视角的整合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略前瞻（Strategic Foresight）、以人为本的设计（Human-Centred Design）、农业创新系统（Agricultural Innovation Systems）
AI.method: 案例研究：一组多样化的科学家利用预定义的未来农业情景，通过前瞻导向设计流程快速协作设计解决方案。
AI.findings: 整合战略前瞻与以人为本的设计填补了文献空白，能有效缩小前瞻与实际影响之间的差距，提升洞察的协调性和可行动性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"前瞻导向设计"这一跨学科整合框架，填补了战略前瞻与设计方法在农业创新系统领域结合的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为农业政策制定者、科研人员和行业从业者提供了从"可预测"转向"可能"未来的实操工具，增强前瞻成果的落地性和跨部门协调响应能力。

title: A Supervisory Machine Learning Framework for Predictive Risk Switching in Financial Markets
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: A Supervisory Machine Learning Framework for Predictive Risk Switching in Financial Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests, personal relationships, institutional affiliations, or conflicts of interest that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, clinical data, animal subjects, or personally identifiable information. Therefore, institutional ethics approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was independently conducted and self-funded by the author. No external funding, grants, or institutional sponsorship were received for this study.

detail.abstract: This paper presents a formal, risk-bounded quantitative framework engineered to eliminate policy drift and out-of-distribution fragility in Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) agents applied to asset allocation within non-stationary financial markets. Purely data-driven architectures frequently exhibit catastrophic performance degradation during structural macroeconomic transformations due to unconstrained parameter search, hidden over-parameterization, and reward function misspecification. To close the loop between highly non-linear parameter exploration and the strict compliance mandates of fiduciary capital preservation, we formalize a closed-loop Supervisory Reinforcement Learning (SRL) architecture integrated with a dynamic Probabilistic Coherence Module (PCM). The supervisory layer maps arbitrary continuous policy actions onto a restricted, risk-admissible convex space in real time by evaluating localized limit order book profiles and latent market regime matrices. We establish theoretical guarantees under strict filtration networks for the operator's non-expansive convergence properties, and prove that operational update variance is explicitly bounded by the underlying network gradient step magnitude. The empirical validity of the framework is cross-examined via a comprehensive out-of-sample walk-forward backtest spanning Equities (SPY), Digital Assets (BTC), Fixed Income (TLT), and Hard Commodities (GLD) from January 2018 through March 2026, alongside simulated CRSP/NASDAQ-style synthetic perturbations. The proposed system demonstrates significant tail-risk suppression under simulated conditions, achieving an institutional Sharpe ratio of 1.54 and restricting maximum drawdown to -7.65%, while statistically dominating traditional unconstrained Soft Actor-Critic (SAC), PPO, A2C, and recurrent LSTM deep portfolio pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"监督式强化学习(SRL)"的风险约束框架，用于解决深度强化学习在非平稳金融市场资产配置中的策略漂移和分布外脆弱性问题。通过动态概率一致性模块将策略映射到风险可接受的凸空间，在2018-2026年的多资产回测中实现了1.54的机构夏普比率和-7.65%的最大回撤。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个形式化、风险有界的定量框架，以消除深度强化学习代理在非平稳金融市场资产配置中的策略漂移和分布外脆弱性？
AI.motivation: 纯数据驱动的DRL架构在结构性宏观经济转型期间，由于无约束参数搜索、隐藏过参数化和奖励函数错误设定，常常出现灾难性性能退化，无法满足 fiduciary 资本保全的合规要求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监督式强化学习(SRL)架构；动态概率一致性模块(PCM)；严格过滤网络下的算子非扩张收敛性证明；操作更新方差受底层网络梯度步长显式约束的数学保证。
AI.method: 设计闭环SRL架构，监督层通过评估局部限价订单簿画像和潜在市场制度矩阵，将任意连续策略动作实时映射到受限的风险可接受凸空间。通过严格过滤网络建立算子的非扩张收敛性理论保证，并证明操作更新方差受梯度步长约束。
AI.findings: 系统在2018年1月至2026年3月的多资产回测中（涵盖SPY、BTC、TLT、GLD及CRSP/NASDAQ合成扰动），实现1.54的机构夏普比率，最大回撤限制在-7.65%，在统计上显著优于传统的无约束SAC、PPO、A2C和循环LSTM深度投资组合方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了监督式强化学习（SRL）架构的形式化框架；建立了非扩张收敛性的理论保证；证明了操作更新方差与梯度步长之间的显式约束关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融领域的DRL应用提供了可落地的风险约束方案，显著抑制尾部风险，满足机构级别的资本保全要求，实现了超越传统方法的投资绩效。

title: LLMs as Gatekeepers: Source Concentration, Factual Quality, and Political Slant in Information Search
affiliations: , Marshall School of Business - University of Southern California and University of Rochester - Simon Business School

detail.title: LLMs as Gatekeepers: Source Concentration, Factual Quality, and Political Slant in Information Search
detail.abstract: As LLM-based search platforms displace traditional search, the information environment they curate increasingly shapes what users see. We study these platforms as a new class of information intermediary. Using 48 months of referral traffic data for 8,082 news domains across five AI platforms (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Grok) and traditional search, linked to publisher-level bot-blocking records, we document three facts. First, AI platforms surface more concentrated content than organic search, but with higher factual quality and, on average, a comparable political slant. No platform dominates: Perplexity is the most factually reliable and most centrist but also the most concentrated, Grok distributes traffic most broadly but is the least factually reliable, and Claude is the most left-leaning.  Second, publishers that block AI crawlers via robots.txt are disproportionately the largest, most factually reliable, and centrist-to-left outlets. This selective exit shifts ChatGPT's and Perplexity's pools toward higher concentration, lower factual quality, and rightward slant; Gemini's concentration also rises, but its factual quality and slant remain largely flat. Third, focusing on Perplexity, we show that blocking Perplexity's crawler cuts the blocking domain's referral traffic by 46-48%. Moreover, the referral traffic that would have gone to blocking domains flows to the largest and highest-factual-quality remaining accessible outlets, with size being the dominant channel, so the referral redistribution reinforces concentration among larger domains rather than diluting it. Together, these findings show that selective publisher opt-outs degrade the quality of the pool of domains AI platforms can refer to, and that the resulting referral-traffic redistribution reinforces concentration while failing to undo the compositional shift toward less factual and more right-leaning publishers.

AI.tldr: 研究AI搜索平台作为新型信息中介的流量分配特征，发现它们比传统搜索更集中但事实质量更高；出版商选择性屏蔽AI爬虫会损害可引用的域名池质量，并加剧流量向大型高事实质量域名的集中。
AI.research_question: AI搜索平台作为新型信息中介如何分配流量？出版商选择性屏蔽AI爬虫会产生怎样的影响？
AI.motivation: 随着基于LLM的搜索平台取代传统搜索，它们策划的信息环境日益影响用户所见内容，但其作为信息中介的角色尚待系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息中介理论、平台治理、选择性退出（opt-out）效应
AI.method: 利用48个月、8,082个新闻域名在五个AI平台（ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini、Claude、Grok）及传统搜索上的引荐流量数据，结合出版商级别的机器人屏蔽记录进行分析。
AI.findings: 1）AI平台比传统搜索更集中但事实质量更高、政治倾向相当；各平台表现差异显著。2）屏蔽AI爬虫的出版商多为大型、高事实质量、中左翼的媒体，导致ChatGPT和Perplexity的池子更集中、事实质量下降、右倾。3）屏蔽Perplexity爬虫使该域名流量下降46-48%，被转移的流量流向剩余的大型高事实质量域名，加剧集中而非稀释。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI搜索平台系统性地界定为新型信息中介，揭示其流量分配特征及出版商选择性退出的结构性后果，补充了平台治理和信息中介理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI平台、出版商和监管者提供实证依据：出版商选择性屏蔽会适得其反，损害信息生态的事实质量和多样性；平台需警惕流量分配中的集中化趋势。

title: Beyond Ratings: A Risk-Based Framework for ESG Integration in Infrastructure Project Finance

detail.title: Beyond Ratings: A Risk-Based Framework for ESG Integration in Infrastructure Project Finance
detail.abstract: The global infrastructure investment market has adopted environmental, social, and governance (ESG) frameworks at accelerating pace, driven by institutional investor mandates, regulatory pressure, and the emergence of specialized benchmarks such as GRESB. Yet prevailing approaches to ESG assessment-aggregate scoring models developed for publicly listed corporations-are structurally misaligned with the risk architecture of infrastructure project finance. This paper diagnoses five structural failures of aggregate ESG scoring when applied to infrastructure: rating divergence of 0.38-0.71 pairwise correlation across major providers (Berg, Kölbel & Rigobon, 2022), corporatesector bias, static snapshot limitations, materiality agnosticism, and greenwashing vulnerability. In response, this paper proposes the Risk-Based ESG Integration Framework (REIF), a five-layer architecture that translates ESG factors into quantifiable adjustments to project internal rates of return (IRR), discount rates, and loss probability estimates. The REIF incorporates physical climate risk through scenario analysis aligned with ISSB S2 standards, transition risk through carbon shadow pricing, social license risk through permitting delay probability, and governance risk through counterparty quality adjustments. Comparative analysis with aggregate ESG scores, GRESB infrastructure benchmarks, and IFC Performance Standards demonstrates that REIF addresses the gap between ESG aspiration and investment-grade risk quantification. The framework is designed for direct integration into project finance underwriting models, enabling institutional investors to satisfy both fiduciary duty and ESG mandate requirements. Policy recommendations address disclosure harmonization, ISSB implementation for infrastructure, and the role of development finance institutions in anchoring ESG risk standards.

AI.tldr: 本文提出风险导向的ESG整合框架（REIF），诊断了传统聚合ESG评分在基础设施项目融资中的五大结构性缺陷，并设计了一套将ESG因素转化为可量化财务指标的五层架构，以弥合ESG愿景与投资级风险量化之间的鸿沟。
AI.research_question: 如何解决传统聚合ESG评分在基础设施项目融资中存在的结构性缺陷，并构建一套与项目融资风险架构相匹配、可量化的ESG整合框架？
AI.motivation: 全球基础设施投资市场正加速采纳ESG框架，但现有的聚合ESG评分模型（为上市公司设计）与基础设施项目融资的风险架构存在结构性错配，导致评分分歧大、静态化、绿色洗白等问题，无法满足机构投资者的受托责任和ESG授权要求。
AI.theoretical_framework: REIF框架；物理气候风险情景分析（参照ISSB S2标准）；转型风险碳影子定价；社会许可风险（许可延迟概率）；治理风险（交易对手质量调整）；项目内部收益率（IRR）、折现率与损失概率的量化调整。
AI.method: 诊断分析（五大结构性缺陷）；比较分析（与聚合ESG评分、GRESB基准、IFC绩效标准对比）；五层架构设计。
AI.findings: 传统聚合ESG评分存在五大缺陷：主要评级机构间配对相关性仅0.38-0.71、企业部门偏差、静态快照局限、重要性无关性、绿色洗白脆弱性。REIF通过将ESG因素转化为IRR、折现率和损失概率的可量化调整，能够弥合ESG愿景与投资级风险量化之间的差距，并可直接整合进项目融资承销模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了针对基础设施项目融资的Risk-Based ESG Integration Framework（REIF），从理论层面系统诊断了传统ESG评分在基础设施领域的结构性失灵，并提供了将ESG因素嵌入项目融资核心财务模型的标准化路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构投资者提供可直接用于项目融资承销模型的ESG量化工具，满足受托责任与ESG授权双重合规要求；为政策制定者提供关于披露协调、ISSB实施及开发性金融机构锚定ESG风险标准的建议。

title: Government Subsidies and the Choice between Bank and Public Debt

detail.title: Government Subsidies and the Choice between Bank and Public Debt
detail.abstract: How do government subsidies affect firms’ capital structure? I find that subsidized firms shift their debt financing structure toward more public debt and away from bank debt. These key findings are robust to alternative regression model specifications and hold under propensity score-matched and entropy-balanced samples as well as an IV approach exploiting changes in powerful congressional committee chairmanships. Cross-sectional tests reveal that the documented effect of government subsidies on the shift toward public debt is amplified among firms with better governance, severe information asymmetry, and more positive political sentiment, consistent with the notion that enhanced external scrutiny and increased perceived credibility stemming from endorsement effects diminish the need for the traditional monitoring and informational roles of bank debt.

AI.tldr: 政府补贴促使企业债务融资结构从银行贷款转向公共债务，源于补贴带来的外部监督增强和感知可信度提升，削弱了银行债务的监督和信息角色。
AI.research_question: 政府补贴如何影响企业的资本结构，特别是债务融资结构？
AI.motivation: 政府补贴是企业重要的外部资源，但其对企业融资决策的影响尚未被充分研究，尤其是对债务结构（银行贷款vs.公共债务）的差异化影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认证效应（Endorsement Effect）：政府补贴传递了积极信号，增强企业外部监督和感知可信度，从而降低企业对银行债务传统监督和信息角色的依赖。
AI.method: 使用倾向得分匹配、熵平衡样本、工具变量法（利用国会委员会主席变更）进行因果识别，并进行横截面异质性分析。
AI.findings: 受补贴企业显著增加公共债务、减少银行债务；这一效应在治理更好、信息不对称更严重、政治情绪更正面的企业中更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次揭示政府补贴通过认证效应影响企业债务融资结构，拓展了资本结构理论中关于外部信号与债务来源选择的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解补贴的意外经济后果提供证据；为企业管理者优化融资结构提供参考。

title: Information Pervasiveness in Micro-Generated Distributional Factor Models

detail.title: Information Pervasiveness in Micro-Generated Distributional Factor Models
detail.abstract: Panels of distributions are often constructed from micro observations.  In this setting, factor strength is a property of the raw likelihood, not only of the Wasserstein geometry of the resulting quantile curves.  This paper shows that the likelihood views a transport loading through a derivative score that rescales the loading by the baseline quantile density.  The induced information, rather than Wasserstein loading energy, determines factor recoverability.  The paper derives the fixed-baseline score, the associated local experiment, and matching oracle upper and raw micro-data local lower bounds for factor-space recovery.  A feasible rank-score PCA implementation reaches the information boundary in baseline-rich regimes and otherwise delivers explicit implementation costs.  The theory yields a tail phase transition: loadings with the same Wasserstein energy can be recoverable or unrecoverable depending on where the baseline distribution places likelihood information.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于微观观测构建的分布面板中，因子强度由似然函数决定而非Wasserstein几何，提出了秩-得分PCA方法，发现了尾部相位转移现象。
AI.research_question: 在分布面板数据中，因子可恢复性是由Wasserstein几何决定还是由似然信息决定？尾部区域的因子恢复是否存在相位转移？
AI.motivation: 传统上分布面板的因子分析侧重于Wasserstein几何，但本文认为似然函数中的因子强度才是关键，需要建立基于信息而非几何距离的因子恢复框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 似然视角下的因子模型、导数得分（derivative score）、基线分位数密度（baseline quantile density）、局部实验（local experiment）、信息边界（information boundary）
AI.method: 推导固定基线得分及局部实验下界；提出秩-得分PCA（rank-score PCA）实现方法；理论推导与Oracle上界匹配。
AI.findings: 因子可恢复性由似然信息而非Wasserstein能量决定；存在尾部相位转移——具有相同Wasserstein能量的载荷，其可恢复性取决于基线分布的似然信息位置。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了因子恢复中信息度量与几何度量的本质区别；提出了尾部相位转移理论，丰富了高维因子模型的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了秩-得分PCA这一可行方法，在基线丰富时达到信息边界；为分布面板的因子分析提供了明确的实现成本评估框架。

title: A Modern Valuation and Capital Structure Framework for Zero-Marginal-Cost Enterprises
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Modern Valuation and Capital Structure Framework for Zero-Marginal-Cost Enterprises
detail.abstract:
