The article further argues that the proposal’s emphasis on digitalisation over substantive legal integration, its broad scope, and its fragmented adjudicatory and governance architecture risk reproducing many of the shortcomings that frustrated earlier attempts to create pan-European corporate forms. Rather than constituting the transformative framework required to support Europe’s innovation economy, EU Inc. emerges as a modest and incomplete reform. 

The article concludes that, unless substantially strengthened during the legislative process, the proposal is unlikely to alter the incentives that continue to drive innovative European firms toward foreign jurisdictions and legal frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性评估了欧盟委员会提出的第28套公司法制度（“EU Inc.”），认为该提案远未达到促进创新、留住高增长企业和强化风险投资生态系统的预期目标。尽管提案引入了无面值股份、SAFE融资工具兼容性、员工股权安排协调化等创新，但保留了大量国家法律引用、成员国自由裁量权和程序妥协，损害了法律统一性和跨境确定性。文章指出该提案已从针对初创企业的工具演变为迎合老牌企业和国家利益的广泛适用形式，若不在立法过程中大幅强化，不太可能改变欧洲创新企业流向外国司法管辖区的趋势。
AI.research_question: 欧盟委员会提出的EU Inc.第28套公司法制度是否能够有效支持创业融资、风险投资和创新经济发展？该提案在多大程度上实现了Letta和Draghi报告所设想的创新导向型法律框架？
AI.motivation: 欧洲创新企业持续流向外国司法管辖区（如美国）的法律制度，现有欧盟公司形式（如SE、SPE）存在缺陷，以及Letta和Draghi报告强调需要统一的泛欧公司法律框架以支持风险投资和创新经济。
AI.theoretical_framework: 刚性公司法规则对风险投资合同和创业融资的阻碍理论；法律统一性与跨境确定性理论；公司法的制度竞争与路径依赖理论。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析与批判性政策评估，基于先前关于公司法规则对风险投资影响的学术研究，结合Letta和Draghi报告的政策目标与EU Inc.提案的具体条款进行对比分析。
AI.findings: (1) EU Inc.提案虽引入了几项创新（无面值股份、SAFE融资工具兼容、员工股权协调化、减少公证要求），但保留了过多的国家法律引用和成员国自由裁量权；(2) 提案范围从初创企业工具扩大为广泛适用的公司形式，迎合了老牌企业和国家利益；(3) 过于强调数字化而非实质法律整合，且裁决和治理架构碎片化；(4) 提案整体为温和且不完整的改革，不太可能改变欧洲创新企业流向外国管辖区的趋势。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对公司法规则刚性如何阻碍风险投资合同和创业融资的理论理解；揭示了法律统一性与成员国利益妥协之间的张力；为泛欧公司形式的制度设计失败提供了新的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟立法者在修订EU Inc.提案过程中提供了具体的缺陷分析和改进方向；警示了数字化替代实质法律整合的风险；有助于政策制定者理解为什么当前提案无法有效阻止欧洲创新企业外流。

title: Enterprise Financial Crime Detection Through Explainable AI: A Case Study of Consolidation and Automation in Multi-Institutional Environments

detail.title: Enterprise Financial Crime Detection Through Explainable AI: A Case Study of Consolidation and Automation in Multi-Institutional Environments

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No Financial Relation to any organization. i am working with different Financial institution and writing my own experience.
declarations.funderStatement: No Funds were collected. I am an individual author who is writing based on my experience.

detail.abstract: This article examines the architecture, implementation, and regulatory outcomes of enterprisescale financial crime detection systems through the lens of explainable artificial intelligence (XAI). Drawing on a decade of practitioner experience consolidating fragmented transaction monitoring infrastructures across multiple business units and regulatory jurisdictions, this case study demonstrates how explainable hybrid ensemble frameworks reduce false-positive rates by 60% while improving detection accuracy to 98.5% across high-risk typologies. The paper addresses a critical gap in financial crime literature: the relationship between model interpretability, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency in multi-institutional environments. Unlike prior research emphasizing pure predictive performance, this work demonstrates that governance-aligned explainability is essential for institutional legitimacy, regulator confidence, and sustainable crime prevention. Through detailed analysis of system consolidation, control propagation, and alert generation workflows, the article contributes both methodological insights for practitionerresearchers and policy recommendations for regulators overseeing AI-driven financial crime systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个企业级金融犯罪检测系统的案例研究，展示了可解释混合集成框架如何将误报率降低60%，检测准确率提升至98.5%，并论证了治理对齐的可解释性对于机构合法性、监管信心和可持续犯罪预防至关重要。
AI.research_question: 在多机构环境中，模型可解释性、监管合规性与运营效率之间的关系如何？
AI.motivation: 以往金融犯罪文献侧重于纯预测性能，忽视了可解释性在监管合规和运营效率中的关键作用，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可解释人工智能（XAI）、混合集成框架、治理对齐的可解释性理论。
AI.method: 基于十年从业经验的案例研究，涉及跨多个业务单元和监管辖区的碎片化交易监控基础设施整合。
AI.findings: 可解释混合集成框架将误报率降低60%，检测准确率提升至98.5%；治理对齐的可解释性对机构合法性和监管信心至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出可解释性不仅是技术问题，更是治理和合法性建构的关键要素，拓展了金融犯罪检测领域的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者研究人员提供系统整合、控制传播和警报生成工作流的方法论洞见；为监管机构提供监管AI驱动金融犯罪系统的政策建议。

title: Optimal Multiple-stopping Strategies for Dynamic Bond Ladder Portfolios
affiliations: , University of California Santa Barbara, University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB) and University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB)

detail.title: Optimal Multiple-stopping Strategies for Dynamic Bond Ladder Portfolios
detail.abstract:
Bond ladder strategies are widely used in fixed income portfolio construction, particularly in insurance asset-liability management and pension investing. Traditional ladder implementations rely on deterministic rebalancing rules and cannot adapt dynamically to evolving yield curve conditions. 

This paper develops an adaptive bond ladder framework in which portfolio interventions such as selling, stripping, and purchasing bonds are formulated as a multiple optimal stopping problem. The resulting stochastic control problem is driven by yield curve dynamics estimated from historical data via a dynamic Nelson-Siegel representation.

To evaluate stopping decisions, we derive analytical approximations to the distribution of portfolio gains using Gram-Charlier density expansions. These approximations allow the expected stopping value to be computed in closed form from moments of the gain distribution. Dominance-probability selection rules are introduced to determine the optimal bond and action at each intervention time. 

Monte Carlo simulations are used to estimate the required moments and to benchmark the analytical approximations. The results demonstrate that the proposed approach delivers accurate value function estimates while achieving substantial computational efficiency relative to brute-force simulation. 

The framework provides a tractable method for integrating dynamic decision rules into bond ladder management and is particularly relevant for insurers and institutional investors operating in multicurve fixed income environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自适应债券阶梯框架，通过多最优停止问题建模债券组合管理中的买卖、剥离等操作，利用动态Nelson-Siegel模型驱动收益率曲线演变，并结合Gram-Charlier密度展开的解析近似与优势概率选择规则，实现了计算高效且准确的价值函数估计，为保险公司和机构投资者在多曲线固定收益环境中提供了一种可处理的动态决策方法。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够动态适应收益率曲线变化的自适应债券阶梯框架，在固定收益组合管理中实现最优的干预决策（卖出、剥离、购买）？
AI.motivation: 传统的债券阶梯策略依赖确定性再平衡规则，无法动态适应收益率曲线的变化，这在保险资产负债管理和养老金投资中可能导致次优表现。因此需要开发一种能够根据市场条件自适应调整的决策框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多最优停止问题、动态Nelson-Siegel收益率曲线表示、Gram-Charlier密度展开、优势概率选择规则
AI.method: 将债券组合干预决策建模为多最优停止问题，利用历史数据估计的动态Nelson-Siegel模型驱动收益率曲线；通过Gram-Charlier密度展开推导组合收益分布的解析近似，以闭式解计算期望停止价值；采用优势概率选择规则确定最优债券和行动；使用蒙特卡洛模拟估计所需矩并验证解析近似效果。
AI.findings: 该方法能够提供准确的价值函数估计，同时相比暴力模拟方法实现了显著的计算效率提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 将多最优停止问题引入债券阶梯管理领域，提出了基于Gram-Charlier密度展开的收益分布解析近似方法，以及优势概率选择规则用于动态决策。
AI.practical_contributions: 为保险公司和机构投资者提供了一种可处理、计算高效的自适应债券阶梯管理工具，特别适用于多曲线固定收益环境中的资产负债管理。

title: Fundamental Limitations of Fixed-Budget Best-Arm Identification

detail.title: Fundamental Limitations of Fixed-Budget Best-Arm Identification
detail.abstract: In fixed-budget best-arm identification, also known as ranking and selection, an algorithm has a sampling budget to distribute across K arms. Each sample provides noisy feedback about that arm's mean, and the goal is to identify the arm with the largest mean. A common performance benchmark is the static oracle: a non-adaptive strategy that knows the means in advance and chooses fixed sampling proportions to maximize the exponential decay rate of the probability of incorrect identification. Several adaptive algorithms have been constructed such that their sampling proportions converge to the static oracle proportions. However, it has remained open whether any algorithm could match the static oracle's error decay rate uniformly across all problem instances. We answer this in the negative. For any K ≥ 3 and for rewards drawn from any one-parameter natural exponential family, we show that for any algorithm, there is at least one instance where the error decay rate is at most 1/(1 + log(K)/8) times that of the static oracle. This also answers the open question posed by Qin (2022), showing that fixed-budget best-arm identification does not admit a complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了在固定预算的最佳臂识别问题中，任何自适应算法都无法在所有问题实例上匹配静态最优策略的错误衰减率，对于K≥3且收益来自单参数自然指数族的情况，误差衰减率最多只有静态最优策略的1/(1+log(K)/8)倍。
AI.research_question: 是否存在一种自适应算法，能够均匀地在所有问题实例上匹配静态最优策略的错误衰减率？
AI.motivation: 固定预算的最佳臂识别（排名与选择）中，自适应算法的采样比例虽能收敛到静态最优比例，但能否在所有实例上均匀匹配静态最优的错误衰减率是一个悬而未决的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 固定预算最佳臂识别、静态最优策略（非自适应）、错误衰减率、单参数自然指数族
AI.method: 理论分析，通过构造反例证明下界
AI.findings: 对于任何K≥3且收益来自单参数自然指数族的算法，总存在至少一个问题实例，其错误衰减率至多为静态最优策略的1/(1+log(K)/8)倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 否定了存在算法能在所有实例上匹配静态最优错误衰减率的可能性；回答了Qin (2022)提出的开放问题，证明固定预算最佳臂识别不具有复杂性（complexity）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为固定预算最佳臂识别算法的设计提供了理论下界，表明算法性能的改进存在根本性限制。

title: Academic Citation Infrastructure: Infrastructure-Level Interventions for Generative Engine Optimization
affiliations: ILLIXIS (illixis.io)

detail.title: Academic Citation Infrastructure: Infrastructure-Level Interventions for Generative Engine Optimization
detail.abstract: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) research has focused exclusively on content-level interventions: adding statistics, citing sources, using authoritative tone, and structuring text for extraction. No peer-reviewed GEO work has proposed infrastructure-level interventions for increasing AI system citation rates. Scattered practitioner recommendations for individual tactics (DOI deposits, ScholarlyArticle schema, repository placement) have emerged independently but remain unconnected, unanalyzed, and untested. This paper proposes the first formal framework for what we term Academic Citation Infrastructure (ACI): the deliberate attachment of scholarly publishing infrastructure to commercial content. ACI unifies four techniques into a coherent strategy: methods-paper formatting,   BibTeX/RIS citation file generation, Zenodo DOI mirroring, and ScholarlyArticle schema markup. Quantitative evidence from source framing studies, repository discoverability research, and LLM search selection analysis supports the underlying mechanisms. This paper unifies these scattered tactics into a testable framework and, as a recursive demonstration, implements all four techniques on itself.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出"学术引用基础设施（ACI）"框架，将四种分散的基建层面策略统一为可测试的方案，旨在提高AI系统对商业内容的引用率，并通过对自身实施所有技术进行递归验证。
AI.research_question: 如何通过基础设施级别的干预（而非内容级别）提高AI系统对商业内容的引用率？
AI.motivation: 现有GEO研究仅关注内容层面的干预（如引用来源、权威语气），缺乏对基础设施层面的系统探索；业界零散的建议（如DOI存储、Schema标记）未被连接、分析和测试。
AI.theoretical_framework: 学术引用基础设施（ACI）框架，包含四种技术：方法-论文格式、BibTeX/RIS引用文件生成、Zenodo DOI镜像、ScholarlyArticle Schema标记。
AI.method: 文献综述与框架整合，并结合递归自我实施（论文自身应用所有四种ACI技术）作为验证。
AI.findings: 来源框架研究、仓储可发现性研究和LLM搜索选择分析为ACI底层机制提供了定量支持；该框架是首个可测试的基建层面GEO策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出ACI概念，将分散的基建层面策略统一为正式框架，拓展了GEO研究的边界从内容层到基础设施层。
AI.practical_contributions: 为内容创作者和出版商提供了具体、可操作的基础设施建设策略，以提升在AI生成内容中的引用可见性和引用率。

title: A Systematic Review of Trustworthy AI for Marketing Measurement in Attribution Media Mix Modeling and Privacy Preserving Methods
affiliations: University of Rochester, Stanford University and

detail.title: A Systematic Review of Trustworthy AI for Marketing Measurement in Attribution Media Mix Modeling and Privacy Preserving Methods
detail.abstract: Marketing measurement faces a triple disruption: privacy regulations restrict user-level data, artificial intelligence transforms modeling capabilities, and largescale field experiments expose systematic biases in platform-reported advertising effectiveness. This systematic review synthesizes 108 studies (2010-2026) on how AI and machine learning reshape measurement across multi-touch attribution, media mix modeling, causal calibration, and privacy-preserving measurement. We develop a two-dimensional taxonomy mapping AI techniques to measurement functions and propose a "Measure-Validate-Protect" (MVP) framework that adapts NIST AI trustworthiness dimensions to marketing contexts. Three findings emerge. First, deep learning attribution improves predictive accuracy but remains causally unidentified without experimental calibration. Second, neural media mix models can outperform traditional Bayesian frameworks in selected benchmark and production settings, yet causal credibility depends on external validation and generalization remains under-tested. Third, privacy-preserving techniques impose measurable accuracy costs: differential privacy reduces precision by 2-33% depending on privacy budget, while federated approaches have retained roughly 90-95% of centralized performance in documented deployments. We identify gaps at the intersection of causal validity and privacy compliance and propose a research agenda for trustworthy marketing AI.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了108篇文献（2010-2026），提出"测量-验证-保护"（MVP）框架，发现深度学习归因虽提升预测精度但缺乏因果识别，神经媒体混合模型优于传统贝叶斯但因果可信度依赖外部验证，隐私保护技术带来2-33%的精度损失，并指出了因果有效性与隐私合规之间的研究空白。
AI.research_question: AI和机器学习如何重塑营销测量？隐私法规、AI变革和大规模现场实验这三重颠覆下，营销测量的现状、挑战与未来方向是什么？
AI.motivation: 营销测量正面临隐私法规限制用户级数据、AI改变建模能力、以及大规模现场实验揭示平台报告广告效果存在系统性偏差这三重颠覆。亟需系统性梳理AI与机器学习如何影响营销测量，并建立可信赖的测量框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 二维分类法（将AI技术与测量功能映射）和"测量-验证-保护"（MVP）框架（将NIST AI可信度维度适配到营销场景）。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述，涵盖108篇2010-2026年的研究。
AI.findings: (1) 深度学习归因提升预测精度但缺乏因果识别；(2) 神经媒体混合模型在某些场景优于传统贝叶斯，但因果可信度依赖外部验证且泛化性不足；(3) 差分隐私导致精度损失2-33%，联邦学习保留集中式性能的90-95%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将AI技术与测量功能映射的二维分类法，以及将NIST AI可信度框架适配到营销测量的MVP框架，填补了因果有效性与隐私合规交叉领域的研究空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为营销人员在隐私受限环境下如何选择测量方法提供了系统指南，指出了不同AI技术在测量中的实际精度成本和因果可信度权衡，为可信赖营销AI的实践提供了研究路线图。

title: Rational Avoidance, Irrational Engagement: On the Economic Rationality of Social Media Use

detail.title: Rational Avoidance, Irrational Engagement: On the Economic Rationality of Social Media Use

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced their study.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the DMSB behavioral lab and grant program.

detail.abstract: This paper tests the economic rationality of social media use as per the Generalized Axiom of Revealed Preference (GARP). Economic rationality is one prerequisite for the effectiveness of taxation and price-based policies to regulate consumption. In a series of four incentive-compatible online and laboratory experiments, including one with a Gen-Z sample, I find that, on average, time allocation decisions between social media use and working for extrinsic rewards appear largely consistent with GARP , and more so than comparable financial decisions under risk of the same individual. This apparent rationality, however, is primarily driven by many consumers who opt out of social media use altogether. Conversely, engaging with social media causes consumers to exhibit significantly lower economic rationality, particularly at higher levels of use. Together with overall inelastic demand, these results suggest that social media consumption may respond only weakly to changes in costs and incentives: some consumers exhibit low price elasticity, while others display limited consistency with revealed-preference rationality. Behavioral interventions, by contrast, appear to shift usage behavior effectively, as I show experimentally. I discuss the results against the background of current discussions about social media bans.

AI.tldr: 本文通过四项激励兼容的实验，检验社交媒体使用是否符合显示偏好广义公理（GARP）。研究发现，平均而言人们在社交媒体使用与工作赚钱之间的时间分配决策基本符合经济理性，但这种理性主要由不使用社交媒体的消费者驱动；使用社交媒体的消费者表现出显著更低的经济理性，尤其在高使用量时更为明显。结合整体缺乏弹性的需求，结果表明社交媒体消费对成本和激励变化的反应可能较弱。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体使用是否符合显示偏好广义公理（GARP）所定义的经济理性？
AI.motivation: 经济理性是税收和价格政策有效调节消费的前提条件。当前关于社交媒体禁令的讨论日益激烈，但社交媒体消费是否具备经济理性尚缺乏系统性检验，这直接关系到政策工具的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 显示偏好理论（Revealed Preference Theory）、广义公理（GARP）、经济理性、需求价格弹性
AI.method: 四项激励兼容的在线和实验室实验（包括一项Z世代样本），采用显示偏好方法检验时间分配决策的GARP一致性，并与同一体在风险下的金融决策进行比较。
AI.findings: (1) 平均而言，社交媒体使用与工作赚钱之间的时间分配决策总体符合GARP，且理性程度高于同一体的金融风险决策；(2) 这种理性主要由不使用社交媒体的消费者驱动；(3) 使用社交媒体的消费者表现出显著更低的经济理性，高使用量时尤其明显；(4) 社交媒体需求整体缺乏弹性；(5) 行为干预能有效改变使用行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将显示偏好理论应用于社交媒体消费领域，揭示了"平均理性"这一表面现象下的异质性机制，区分了不使用者和使用者两类群体的理性差异，为理解数字消费行为的经济学基础提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：由于社交媒体消费需求缺乏弹性且使用者理性程度低，传统的税收和价格政策可能效果有限；行为干预可能比经济激励更有效。这对当前关于社交媒体禁令的讨论具有直接的政策参考价值。

title: Data Challenges in Institutional Rankings: Evidence from HEIS in the Marathwada Region

detail.title: Data Challenges in Institutional Rankings: Evidence from HEIS in the Marathwada Region

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on observational analysis and does not involve human participants or personal data. Therefore, ethical approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
This study examines the data-related challenges faced by Higher Education Institutions (HEIs) in institutional ranking frameworks, with special emphasis on the Marathwada region of Maharashtra. The study focuses on three key issues: limited understanding of ranking parameters among faculty, inadequate technical infrastructure for data management, and a compliance-oriented approach arising from compulsory participation in frameworks such as the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF). The research adopts a qualitative, observation-based approach, drawing on the researcher’s direct involvement in institutional data processes from 2016 to 2025. 

The findings reveal that faculty members often perceive data collection as an administrative obligation rather than a quality enhancement activity, resulting in superficial compilation and inconsistencies in data submission. Additionally, many institutions—particularly in rural areas—lack essential digital infrastructure, including Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems and centralized data management tools, leading to inefficiencies and reliability concerns. The study further highlights that mandatory participation has shifted institutional focus toward procedural compliance rather than meaningful quality improvement.

 To address these challenges, the study recommends strengthening Institutional Quality Assurance Cells (IQACs), implementing structured faculty development programs, promoting digital infrastructure, and enhancing awareness regarding the purpose and utility of ranking frameworks. The study underscores the importance of integrating data-driven decision-making and continuous monitoring to improve institutional performance and educational outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了印度马哈拉施特拉邦马拉特瓦达地区高等教育机构在排名框架（特别是NIRF）中面临的数据挑战，包括教职员工对排名参数理解有限、技术基础设施不足以及合规导向问题。基于2016-2025年的观察，研究发现数据收集被视为行政义务而非质量提升活动，农村地区缺乏ERP等数字基础设施，强制参与导致机构关注程序合规而非实质性改进。建议加强IQAC、实施教师发展计划、推进数字基础设施并提升排名框架认知。
AI.research_question: 高等教育机构在机构排名框架（特别是NIRF）中面临哪些数据相关挑战？
AI.motivation: 高等教育排名框架日益重要，但许多机构（尤其是发展中国家欠发达地区的机构）在数据管理和排名合规方面面临系统性困难，亟需深入研究以提出改进建议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据管理理论、机构排名框架合规理论、质量保障理论
AI.method: 定性、观察为基础的研究方法，基于研究者2016年至2025年直接参与机构数据过程的经验。
AI.findings: (1) 教职员工将数据收集视为行政义务而非质量提升活动，导致数据汇编肤浅且不一致；(2) 许多机构（尤其是农村地区）缺乏ERP系统和集中数据管理工具等关键数字基础设施；(3) 强制性参与使机构关注点从实质性质量改进转向程序合规。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统揭示了强制排名框架下"合规导向"与"质量提升"之间的张力，为理解发展中国家高等教育机构数据管理困境提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议加强机构质量保障小组（IQAC）、实施结构化教师发展计划、推广数字基础设施、提升对排名框架目的和效用的认知，以促进数据驱动决策和持续监控。

title: A Probabilistic Feasibility Assessment of Semiconductor Fabrication Plant Expansion Using Monte Carlo-Integrated DCF Analysis
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: A Probabilistic Feasibility Assessment of Semiconductor Fabrication Plant Expansion Using Monte Carlo-Integrated DCF Analysis
detail.abstract: Investors face risks in greenfield semiconductor fabrication plant expansion such as construction delays, yield ramp uncertainty and sudden escalation of operating costs. Deterministic cash flow models (DCF) fail to take these uncertainties into account and hence understate downside exposure. To address this, Monte Carlo based DCF model has been constructed in which we took construction delay as a continuous PERT(0,3,18) distribution. Operating costs were set to evolve as a Geometric Brownian motion (GBM) process and subjected it to Ito volatility drag, and also captured joint cost-yield dependence using a Clayton copula configured to Kendall's τ ≈ 0.45. Then, three geographic volatility regimes were chosen (σ ∈ {0.15, 0.28, 0.40}) for proxy supply chain conditions across the United States/Europe, India/South East Asia, and Taiwan/South Korea. After running 10,000 simulations, the baseline (United States/Europe) returned a mean NPV of USD -394.73 million, a median of USD -393.63 million, a fifth percentile of USD -853.30 million, and a P95 of USD +60.34 million; concluded that only 8.1% of runs are NPV positive. An essential takeaway of this paper was that the GBM cost of escalation against fixed wafer price revenue generated a perennially left-skewed NPV (Net Present Value) distribution which is a tail-risk structure that deterministic DCF suppressed when it substituted the mean cost path for the entire stochastic distribution. This resulted in a probabilistic feasibility map that lets capital allocators compare tail exposure across various geographic scenarios under any revised set of assumptions.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了基于蒙特卡洛模拟的晶圆厂扩张折现现金流模型，将施工延误、运营成本几何布朗运动、良率-成本联合依赖等不确定性纳入分析，发现确定性DCF模型掩盖了左偏尾部风险，只有8.1%的模拟情境下净现值为正。
AI.research_question: 在绿色field半导体晶圆厂扩张中，如何将多重不确定性纳入现金流模型以准确评估投资项目的下行风险和尾部风险？
AI.motivation: 传统的确定性现金流模型（DCF）无法考虑施工延误、良率不确定性及运营成本激增等风险，会低估投资的下行风险暴露。
AI.theoretical_framework: 蒙特卡洛模拟、几何布朗运动（GBM）与伊藤漂移、Clayton Copula联合分布、PERT分布、净现值（NPV）分析。
AI.method: 构建蒙特卡洛DCF模型：施工延迟设为PERT(0,3,18)分布；运营成本设定为几何布朗运动并施加伊藤波动率拖曳；使用Clayton Copula（Kendall's τ ≈ 0.45）捕捉成本与良率的联合依赖关系；选取三个波动率体制（σ ∈ {0.15, 0.28, 0.40}）代表不同地区的供应链条件；运行10,000次模拟。
AI.findings: 基准情景（美国/欧洲）NPV均值为-3.9473亿美元，中位数为-3.9363亿美元，第5百分位为-8.533亿美元，第95百分位为+6034万美元；仅8.1%的模拟结果为NPV正值；GBM成本上涨与固定晶圆价格的组合导致NPV分布持续左偏，形成尾部风险结构，而确定性DCF用均值路径替代整个随机分布，掩盖了该风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了确定性DCF模型在资本密集型制造项目评估中系统性低估尾部风险的机制——用均值路径替代全部分布会掩盖成本演进的不对称性所带来的左偏NPV结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了概率化可行性地图，使资本配置者能够在不同地理场景和假设下比较尾部风险暴露，助力半导体晶圆厂扩张投资决策。

title: Does the Veblen Effect Exist? An Analysis of its Likelihood in Luxury Consumption and Potential Consequences for Pricing Management
affiliations: The Bridge to Luxury

detail.title: Does the Veblen Effect Exist? An Analysis of its Likelihood in Luxury Consumption and Potential Consequences for Pricing Management
detail.abstract: Luxury pricing follows management rules that are different from fast-moving consumer goods. In particular, the Veblen effect – hypothesising that higher prices prompt higher consumer demand – has fascinated academia and business practice for decades within the context of theories such as conspicuous consumption or social signalling. This article presents a new assessment demonstrating that this effect – if it exists at all – is only temporary and limited in scope as exemplified by the empirical data of the Swiss watch industry and sports car manufacturer Ferrari from 2000 to 2025. To this end, the analysis first defines the concept of luxury within the framework of an innovative semantic system. It describes the specific characteristics of luxury pricing, focusing particularly on consumer needs and their potential relevance for the assumed existence of the Veblen effect. As the analysis concludes that the effect barely exists, implying a much more complex context for luxury pricing, the article outlines specifics in luxury pricing management.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了奢侈品领域长期存在的凡勃伦效应（价格越高需求越旺），通过瑞士手表行业和法拉利2000-2025年的实证数据表明，该效应即使存在也仅是暂时的、有限的，奢侈品定价管理比传统认知更为复杂。
AI.research_question: 凡勃伦效应（高价刺激高需求）在奢侈品市场中是否真实存在？其持续性和作用范围如何？
AI.motivation: 凡勃伦效应自提出以来一直影响奢侈品定价理论与实践，但缺乏系统的实证检验。本文旨在用长期真实数据验证这一假设的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 凡勃伦效应、炫耀性消费理论、社会信号理论、奢侈品语义系统框架
AI.method: 构建创新的奢侈品语义系统进行概念界定，采用瑞士手表行业和法拉利2000-2025年的实证数据进行案例分析。
AI.findings: 凡勃伦效应即使存在，也只是暂时的、有限的；奢侈品定价的实际情境比该效应所描述的更为复杂。
AI.theory_contributions: 质疑并修正了凡勃伦效应在奢侈品领域的普遍适用性，提出了奢侈品定价管理需要超越简单"高价刺激需求"的理论认知。
AI.practical_contributions: 为奢侈品企业管理者提供了更精细化的定价策略指导，避免盲目依赖提价刺激需求的神话。

title:
Beyond HR: Recruitment Marketing as a Performance System in U.S. Trucking 
A Data-Driven Framework for CDL Driver Acquisition
affiliations: Independent Researcher & Marketing Strategist

detail.title:
Beyond HR: Recruitment Marketing as a Performance System in U.S. Trucking 
A Data-Driven Framework for CDL Driver Acquisition

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author conducted this research independently in collaboration with MIR Transportation, which provided access to operational and internal business data relevant to the study. The author declares no personal financial interests or conflicts that could have improperly influenced the research findings, analysis, or conclusions.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was conducted using company-provided operational and business data. No medical, clinical, or human subject experimentation was involved. Any information used in the research was handled in accordance with standard confidentiality and professional research practices.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant or external academic funding. MIR Transportation provided access to internal operational data and industry insights used for analytical purposes within the study.

detail.abstract: The U.S. trucking industry faces a structural workforce crisis characterized by persistent driver shortages and annual turnover rates exceeding 90 percent among large truckload carriersconditions that compensation-driven recruitment strategies have consistently failed to resolve. This study examines how data-driven recruitment marketing frameworks operate within this context, with particular attention to CDL driver acquisition. Drawing on academic recruitment theory, secondary industry data, and practitioner-level operational observations obtained through collaborative access to an active U.S.-based trucking carrier, the analysis develops an integrated framework across four dimensions: digital trust architecture, employer brand differentiation, recruitment channel strategy, and funnel performance analytics. The study argues that CDL driver recruitment is increasingly governed by marketing-system logic rather than traditional HR process-and that carriers which apply integrated recruitment marketing frameworks demonstrate measurable advantages in acquisition efficiency, applicant quality, and retention outcomes. Grounded in signaling theory (Spence, 1973), employer branding research (Backhaus & Tikoo, 2004), and recruitment process scholarship (Breaugh, 2013), the analysis demonstrates that digital trust signals function as conversion variables rather than reputational amenities, that employer brand differentiation reduces dependence on compensation-based competition, and that funnel analytics enable recruitment decisions to be evaluated with the same precision applied to customer acquisition systems. Structural characteristics of the trucking industry-including fragmented carrier landscapes, small-fleet dominance, and historically transactional hiring models-are examined as conditions that have slowed adoption of these frameworks while simultaneously amplifying their potential impact. The study contributes an industry-specific analytical framework for CDL recruitment marketing, positions practitioner observations within a theoretically grounded research design, and identifies directions for subsequent empirical investigation at greater organizational scale.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国卡车运输业CDL驾驶员招聘问题，提出数据驱动的招聘营销框架（数字信任架构、雇主品牌差异化、招聘渠道策略、漏斗绩效分析），认为该行业招聘正从传统HR流程转向营销系统逻辑，采用整合框架的承运商在招聘效率、申请者质量和留任方面具有显著优势。
AI.research_question: 数据驱动的招聘营销框架如何在美国卡车运输业CDL驾驶员招聘中发挥作用？特别是数字信任、雇主品牌、渠道策略和漏斗分析四个维度如何影响招聘效果？
AI.motivation: 美国卡车运输业面临严重的结构性用工危机（驾驶员持续短缺、年流失率超90%），而传统的薪酬驱动招聘策略始终未能解决问题，亟需新的理论框架和实践指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论（Spence, 1973）、雇主品牌研究（Backhaus & Tikoo, 2004）、招聘过程学术研究（Breaugh, 2013）
AI.method: 理论分析结合二次行业数据，以及通过合作接入美国某活跃卡车承运商获得的实践层面运营观察。
AI.findings: (1) 数字信任信号是转化变量而非声誉附属品；(2) 雇主品牌差异化减少对薪酬竞争的依赖；(3) 漏斗分析使招聘决策能以客户获取系统的精度进行评估；(4) 行业结构性特征（碎片化、小车队主导、交易型招聘模式）既阻碍了框架采用，也放大了其潜在影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将信号理论、雇主品牌理论和招聘过程理论整合应用于卡车运输业这一特殊背景，提出了行业特定的CDL招聘营销分析框架，并将实践观察置于理论指导的研究设计中。
AI.practical_contributions: 为卡车运输承运商提供了可操作的招聘营销四大维度框架，展示了整合框架在招聘效率、申请者质量和留任方面的优势，为行业应对用工危机提供了新路径。

title: Overcoming Data Sparsity in Ride-Hailing Demand Prediction: A Transfer Learning Framework for Emerging Cities

detail.title: Overcoming Data Sparsity in Ride-Hailing Demand Prediction: A Transfer Learning Framework for Emerging Cities
detail.abstract: Accurate ride-hailing demand prediction is critical for fleet management and dynamic pricing, yet remains challenging in emerging cities where historical trip data are sparse or entirely absent. While deep learning models have achieved state-of-the-art performance in data-rich metropolitan areas, their effectiveness degrades sharply when transferred to cities with limited observations due to domain shifts in spatial layouts, point-of-interest distributions, and travel patterns. This paper proposes a transfer learning framework designed specifically for ridehailing demand prediction under extreme data sparsity in emerging urban contexts. The framework integrates three key components: (1) a spatiotemporal feature alignment module that learns city-agnostic representations from source cities with abundant data using adversarial domain adaptation; (2) a meta-learning initialization strategy that enables rapid fine-tuning with as few as 7-14 days of target-city data; and (3) a graph-based region embedding mechanism that encodes transferable road network and land-use features without requiring historical demand records. Experiments conducted on real-world trip data from three data-rich source cities and four emerging target cities across two continents demonstrate that the proposed framework reduces prediction error by 38-52% compared to training from scratch and outperforms existing domain adaptation baselines by 15-23% in terms of RMSE. Notably, with only one week of target-city data, the framework achieves accuracy comparable to models trained on three months of local data, offering a practical pathway for deploying intelligent mobility services in rapidly growing but data-scarce urban environments.

AI.tldr: 针对新兴城市网约车需求预测中历史数据极端稀疏的问题，本文提出了一种迁移学习框架，通过对抗域自适应、元学习初始化和图嵌入技术，仅用7-14天数据即可达到传统模型需三个月数据才能实现的预测精度。
AI.research_question: 如何在历史数据极端稀疏甚至完全缺失的新兴城市中，实现高精度的网约车需求预测？
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习模型在数据丰富的城市表现优异，但迁移到数据稀疏的新兴城市时，由于空间布局、POI分布和出行模式的域偏移，模型性能急剧下降；而新兴城市恰恰最需要智能出行服务，存在巨大的实际需求缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 迁移学习、对抗域自适应、元学习、图神经网络嵌入
AI.method: 提出包含三个核心模块的迁移学习框架：(1)基于对抗域自适应的时空特征对齐模块，学习城市无关表征；(2)元学习初始化策略，支持仅7-14天数据快速微调；(3)基于图的区域嵌入机制，编码可迁移的道路网络和土地利用特征。
AI.findings: 在两大洲三个数据丰富城市和四个新兴目标城市的真实数据集上，该框架相比从零训练降低预测误差38-52%，比现有域自适应基线提升15-23%的RMSE；仅用一周目标城市数据即可达到用三个月本地数据训练的模型精度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将对抗域自适应和元学习首次系统性地应用于网约车需求预测这一特定时空预测问题，证明了极端数据稀疏条件下迁移学习框架的有效性；提出了不依赖历史需求记录的图嵌入编码方法，扩展了时空预测在零样本场景下的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数据匮乏的新兴城市提供了可落地的智能出行部署方案，大幅降低了智能交通服务推广所需的数据门槛；对网约车平台在新市场的车辆调度和动态定价策略具有直接的应用价值。

title: Nigeria's Net-Zero Ambitions And Coal-Fired Power Plants: Is There A Legal Prohibition?
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Nigeria's Net-Zero Ambitions And Coal-Fired Power Plants: Is There A Legal Prohibition?
detail.abstract:
Nigeria’s commitment to achieving net-zero greenhouse gas emissions between 2050 and 2070 has intensified debates regarding the compatibility of fossil fuel projects with the country’s climate obligations, particularly coal-fired power generation. This article critically examines whether Nigerian law expressly prohibits the construction and operation of coal-fired power plants within the framework of Nigeria’s net-zero ambitions. Through a doctrinal analysis of Nigeria’s mining, electricity, environmental, and climate governance regimes, the article evaluates the legal status of coal-fired electricity generation under existing statutes, regulations, policy instruments, and international climate commitments.

The article demonstrates that no Nigerian legislation currently imposes an outright prohibition on coal-fired power plants. The Nigerian Minerals and Mining Act 2007 permits coal exploration and exploitation, while the Electricity Act 2023 authorises electricity generation from both renewable and non-renewable sources, subject to regulatory approval. Likewise, environmental regulations issued by the National Environmental Standards and Regulations Enforcement Agency (NESREA) recognise fossil fuel-based energy projects and prescribe compliance standards rather than prohibitions. Significantly, Nigeria’s Energy Transition Plan contemplates the continued inclusion of coal-generated electricity within the country’s future energy mix, notwithstanding its decarbonisation objectives.

Notwithstanding the absence of a statutory ban, the article argues that coal-fired power projects in Nigeria face substantial regulatory, financial, political, and environmental constraints. The prevailing policy climate increasingly prioritises renewable energy development, while international financing institutions and commercial banks continue to retreat from coal financing due to global decarbonisation commitments. Furthermore, coal-fired projects are likely to encounter heightened environmental compliance obligations, public interest litigation risks, and regulatory hesitation arising from Nigeria’s climate commitments under the Paris Agreement and the Climate Change Act 2021.

The article concludes that Nigeria presently adopts a transitional and pragmatic approach to energy governance, balancing climate commitments with energy security and developmental considerations. Although coal-fired power generation remains legally permissible, evolving regulatory attitudes, market realities, and climate governance trends may render such projects increasingly impracticable in the long term.

AI.tldr: 本文通过法律条文分析，论证尼日利亚现行法律并未明确禁止煤电项目，但受气候承诺、融资环境、监管趋势等因素影响，煤电项目在长期将面临越来越大的可行性挑战。尼日利亚采取了一种过渡性、务实的能源治理策略。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚法律是否明确禁止在其净零排放目标框架下建设与运营燃煤发电厂？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚承诺在2050至2070年间实现净零排放，但该国仍存在化石燃料项目（尤其是煤电）的争议。需要厘清国内法律是否真正禁止煤电，以调和气候义务与能源发展之间的矛盾。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律条文分析（Doctrinal Analysis）；以尼日利亚矿业法、电力法、环境法及气候治理制度为基础，结合国际气候承诺进行合法性评估。
AI.method: 法律教义分析（Doctrinal Analysis），对尼日利亚现行成文法、法规、政策文件及国际气候承诺进行系统梳理与解释。
AI.findings: 1. 尼日利亚现行法律并未明确禁止燃煤发电；《矿业法2007》允许煤炭开采，《电力法2023》允许包括化石燃料在内的发电方式。2. 环境法规仅设定合规标准而非禁令。3. 能源转型计划仍将煤电纳入未来能源组合。4. 尽管法律未禁止，但煤电项目面临融资困难、环境合规成本上升、公共利益诉讼风险及政策不确定性等实质性障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了发展中国家在气候承诺与能源安全之间的法律张力，补充了"渐进式能源治理"的法律分析视角，表明法律未禁止不等于实践可行。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚政府、投资者和能源企业提供法律风险评估：煤电项目虽合法但不可行；建议政策制定者加速可再生能源转型并完善监管框架。

title: Global Knowledge, Local Capability: Rethinking Technology Transfer in West Africa
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Global Knowledge, Local Capability: Rethinking Technology Transfer in West Africa

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare that there are no competing financial, professional, or personal interests that could have influenced the research, analysis, or publication of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based entirely on secondary data, publicly available reports, academic literature, and policy documents. It did not involve human participants, personal data collection, or experimental procedures requiring formal ethical approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant, funding, or financial support from any public, commercial, or non-profit funding agency. This research was independently conducted as part of a broader intellectual and academic preparation for advanced studies in Global Markets and Development. The study reflects my growing research interest in technology transfer, industrial transformation, and the relationship between global economic systems and local development in emerging economies, particularly within the West African context. No external funding or financial support was received for this research.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the persistent gap between technology transfer and industrial development in West Africa, arguing that access to global technology alone is insufficient for sustainable economic transformation. Drawing on insights from Global Value Chain Theory, absorptive capacity, and technological capability frameworks, the study explores why integration into global production systems has not consistently translated into strong domestic industrial capacity. The paper situates West Africa within contemporary global production networks, where the region remains largely dependent on low-value activities such as raw material exports. It traces this challenge to colonial extraction systems and post-independence industrialization efforts that failed to develop deep technological capabilities. The study identifies a central paradox: despite increasing access to foreign technologies and industrial partnerships, domestic capacity to absorb, adapt, and innovate remains limited. Using case-based analysis, the paper contrasts unsuccessful industrial experiences with more promising developments, particularly the collaboration between the Dangote Group and ThyssenKrupp. It argues that sustainable development requires a transition from technology transfer to technological capability and ultimately industrial transformation. The paper concludes that West Africa's long-term development depends not merely on access to global technology, but on its ability to convert global knowledge into locally embedded industrial capability.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨西非技术转移与工业发展之间的持续差距，认为获取全球技术不足以实现可持续经济转型。通过全球价值链理论、吸收能力和技术能力框架，研究为何融入全球生产体系未能转化为强大的国内工业能力，并提出从技术转移走向技术能力再到工业转型的必要路径。
AI.research_question: 为什么西非地区融入全球生产体系后，技术转移未能有效转化为本土工业能力与经济转型？
AI.motivation: 西非长期依赖低附加值原材料出口，尽管越来越多地接触外国技术和工业合作，但国内吸收、适应和创新能力仍然有限，这一持续存在的差距亟需理论解释和政策回应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球价值链理论、吸收能力框架、技术能力框架
AI.method: 基于案例的比较分析，对比失败工业经验与成功案例（Dangote集团与ThyssenKrupp的合作）
AI.findings: 西非面临核心悖论：技术获取增加但本土能力有限；殖民体系遗留与后独立工业化努力未能培养深层技术能力；成功案例表明，从技术转移到技术能力再到工业转型是可持续路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合全球价值链、吸收能力与技术能力三个理论视角，揭示技术转移不等于能力形成的机制；提出从"技术转移→技术能力→工业转型"的三阶段理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为西非及类似地区政策制定者提供路径指导：发展应聚焦于将全球知识转化为本地嵌入的工业能力，而非单纯追求技术获取。

reference: Remote Sensing Applications: Society and Environment, volume 42, 2026[10.1016/j.rsase.2026.101963]
title: Forecasting the time of failure of tailings dams and Heap Leach Facilities through satellite InSAR data: myth or reality?
affiliations: University of Florence - Department of Earth Sciences, Norwegian Geotechnical Institute, Norwegian Geotechnical Institute, Norwegian Geotechnical Institute, University of Florence and University of Florence

detail.title: Forecasting the time of failure of tailings dams and Heap Leach Facilities through satellite InSAR data: myth or reality?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Remote Sensing Applications: Society and Environment, volume 42, 2026[10.1016/j.rsase.2026.101963]

detail.abstract: This paper addresses the complex challenge of forecasting the Time of Failure (ToF) for Tailings Storage Facilities (TSFs) and Heap Leach Facilities (HLFs) using satellite-based Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar (InSAR) data. TSF and HLF structures can be susceptible to different failure modes, some of which can result in sudden instability due to the tailings' contractive and brittle behaviour. Moreover, the infrequent satellite passes can limit the ability to detect rapid changes or deformations in these structures, potentially reducing the effectiveness of monitoring efforts. Some recent papers propose predicting brittle failures in such structures using tertiary creep-based forecasting methods. However, this often requires a subjective procedure, and the results yielded are sometimes different and sometimes contradictory. To fully exploit the predictive potential of satellite InSAR data, a statistical multi-model methodology is introduced, with a primary focus on providing both quantitative estimates of the predictions and forecasting reliability. Through this methodology, different levels of warnings are issued. Low confidence alert would have been reached for Cadia up to 2 months in advance, whereas the highly confident one 12 days prior to the collapse. For Feijão moderate confidence alert would have been reached 39 days before failure. Special emphasis is placed on the evolution of failure risk in a simulated prospective manner, reproducing operational monitoring conditions. Our findings highlight the need for multiple technologies to accurately monitor such structures and justify the use of satellite InSAR for hazard screening.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于卫星InSAR数据的统计多模型方法，用于预测尾矿库和堆浸设施的失效时间，并在Cadia和Feijão案例中验证了其预警能力。
AI.research_question: 如何利用卫星InSAR数据对尾矿库（TSF）和堆浸设施（HLF）的失效时间（ToF）进行有效预测？
AI.motivation: 尾矿库和堆浸设施存在多种破坏模式，可能因尾矿的收缩性和脆性行为导致突然失稳；卫星重访间隔长限制了对快速变形的监测能力；现有基于三期蠕变的预测方法主观性强且结果不一致。
AI.theoretical_framework: 卫星InSAR形变监测、三期蠕变理论、统计多模型预测方法、失效风险评估。
AI.method: 提出一种统计多模型方法，利用卫星InSAR数据提供定量预测和预测可靠性估计，按不同置信水平（低、中、高）发布预警，并以模拟前瞻性方式评估失效风险的演化过程。
AI.findings: Cadia案例：低置信预警可提前2个月发出，高置信预警在坍塌前12天发出；Feijão案例：中等置信预警在失效前39天发出。研究强调需要多种技术协同监测，卫星InSAR适用于风险筛查。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种统计多模型框架，克服了传统三期蠕变方法的主观性和结果不一致问题，增强了卫星InSAR数据的预测潜力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尾矿库和堆浸设施提供了可操作的预警等级方案（低/中/高置信度），并在真实案例中验证了预警提前量，支持将卫星InSAR用于工程设施的风险筛查与日常监测。

title: 0DTE Options and the Price of Tail Protection
affiliations: City University of Hong Kong (CityU)

detail.title: 0DTE Options and the Price of Tail Protection
detail.abstract: On May 16, 2022, the addition of Tuesday and Thursday weekly expirations extended SPX same-day-expiry (0DTE) options to every weekday. SPX put skew compressed across tenors, peaking at 71 basis points at 30 days. A cross-tenor difference-in-differences design and the staggered identical 0DTE expansion in the Russell 2000 twenty months later rule out alternative drivers. Two reinforcing channels operate at distinct tenor bands: customer flow substitutes into pure-intraday 0DTE contracts at the short end, and dealer warehousing costs fall, with dealers absorbing more put-gamma at intermediate tenors. The implied annual reduction in the cost of equity tail insurance is approximately $1.4 billion. Post-2022 skew partly reflects intermediation-cost changes alongside tail-risk preferences.

AI.tldr: SPX 0DTE期权扩展至每个工作日后，PUT偏斜在所有期限上压缩（30天峰值为71基点），通过双重差分设计和R2000的类似扩展排除了替代解释。两条渠道：短端客户转向纯日内0DTE合约，中间期限做市商仓储成本下降、吸收更多PUT gamma。权益尾部保险年化成本降低约14亿美元。
AI.research_question: SPX 0DTE期权扩展至每个工作日如何影响期权市场的PUT偏斜结构？其背后的传导机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 2022年5月16日，SPX期权将周二和周四的每周到期日加入，使同日到期（0DTE）期权覆盖每个工作日。这一制度变化为研究期权市场微观结构如何影响偏斜提供了准自然实验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期权市场微观结构理论、做市商存货成本理论、客户订单流替代效应
AI.method: 跨期限双重差分（Difference-in-Differences）设计，并利用罗素2000指数20个月后类似的0DTE扩展作为安慰剂检验。
AI.findings: （1）SPX PUT偏斜在所有期限上压缩，30天偏斜峰值下降71个基点；（2）两个强化渠道在不同期限带运作：短端客户订单流替代至纯日内0DTE合约，中间期限做市商仓储成本下降、吸收更多PUT gamma；（3）权益尾部保险年化成本降低约14亿美元；（4）2022年后偏斜部分反映了中介成本变化而非仅尾部风险偏好。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次识别出期权到期日结构扩展通过客户替代效应和做市商仓储成本两条渠道影响偏斜，将中介摩擦纳入偏斜定价框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 量化了0DTE期权扩展对尾部保险成本的降低效应（年化约14亿美元），为监管者和市场参与者理解期权产品创新对市场定价的影响提供实证依据。

title: Long-Term Memory Approach for Calibrating Driving Behavior Parameters in VISSIM Models: A Comparative Study

detail.title: Long-Term Memory Approach for Calibrating Driving Behavior Parameters in VISSIM Models: A Comparative Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Microscopic traffic simulation models such as PTV VISSIM are widely used for operational analysis and evaluation. The efficiency and trustworthiness of these models depend strongly on careful calibration of driving behavior and related input distributions. Genetic Algorithms are used to calibrate the driving behavior parameters to mimic the real-life driving behavior. This paper proposes the Hall of Fame evolutionary framework offering a long-term memory as an alternative to the typical Genetic Algorithm. The paper compares the typical, shortterm memory, Genetic Algorithm with the proposed framework in terms of calibration speed. Data collected on a 3.15 miles corridor on I-64 in Saint Louis, Missouri and 5 years suggest that the Hall of Fame algorithm offers a faster calibration for the driving behavior parameters. In two scenarios, the proposed algorithm achieved lower errors than the typical algorithm in a short period of time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"名人堂"（Hall of Fame）的进化框架，通过引入长期记忆机制来替代传统遗传算法，用于微观交通仿真模型PTV VISSIM中驾驶行为参数的校准。基于美国密苏里州圣路易斯I-64公路3.15英里走廊5年的数据验证表明，该算法在参数校准速度上优于传统遗传算法。
AI.research_question: 如何通过改进遗传算法的记忆机制，提高微观交通仿真模型中驾驶行为参数的校准效率？
AI.motivation: 微观交通仿真模型的可靠性和效率高度依赖于驾驶行为参数和输入分布的精确校准，而传统遗传算法在校准过程中存在收敛速度慢的问题，亟需更高效的校准方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 进化算法（Evolutionary Algorithm）、遗传算法（Genetic Algorithm）、名人堂进化框架（Hall of Fame evolutionary framework）——通过长期记忆机制保留优秀个体，加速参数优化过程。
AI.method: 对比实验设计：将传统遗传算法（短期记忆）与名人堂进化框架（长期记忆）在PTV VISSIM模型校准中进行比较。数据来源为美国密苏里州圣路易斯I-64公路3.15英里走廊5年的真实交通数据。
AI.findings: 名人堂算法在两种场景下均实现了比传统遗传算法更快的校准速度，在更短的时间内达到了更低的误差水平，验证了长期记忆机制在驾驶行为参数校准中的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了名人堂进化框架这一改进的进化算法，引入长期记忆机制作为传统遗传算法的替代方案，丰富了进化算法在交通仿真校准领域的理论应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交通仿真实践提供了一种更高效的参数校准方法，能够加快PTV VISSIM等微观交通仿真模型的校准速度，提高模型在实际交通工程应用中的可信度和实用性。

title: Operationalizing Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) as a Sovereign Empowerment Rail to Mitigate Capital Flight and Resolve the Career Advancement Scheme Apparatus in India's Higher Education Ecosystem
affiliations: DES Shri Navalmal Firodia Law College

detail.title: Operationalizing Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) as a Sovereign Empowerment Rail to Mitigate Capital Flight and Resolve the Career Advancement Scheme Apparatus in India's Higher Education Ecosystem
detail.abstract:
Background. India has constructed sovereign Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) for identity (Aadhaar), payments (UPI), document custody (DigiLocker), commerce (ONDC), and consent management (Account Aggregator). Despite a public higher education ecosystem comprising over 1,100 universities, 45,000 colleges, and a research workforce sustained almost entirely by taxpayer expenditure (UGC, 2024), validation of Indian scholarly output remains dominantly intermediated by foreign-controlled commercial publishing infrastructures (Ministry of Education, 2024; OECD, 2023).

Purpose. This paper conceptualises, doctrinally analyses, and econometrically evaluates Project SARASWATI, a proposed sovereign research-validation DPI designed to function as the missing "Research Layer" of India Stack. The paper interrogates how the Career Advancement Scheme (CAS) apparatus under University Grants Commission (UGC) regulations interacts with extractive Article Processing Charge (APC) regimes to produce a structural capital outflow, a fiscal paradox, and an institutional deadlock affecting Indian faculty, particularly in Maharashtra's state university system.

Methodology. The study deploys a multi-method framework integrating doctrinal legal analysis of the UGC Act, NEP 2020, and the National Research Foundation framework; institutional analysis of universities under Savitribai Phule Pune University, University of Mumbai, RTM Nagpur University, and Shivaji University; econometric modelling of APC outflows using publicly available pricing data from Elsevier, Springer Nature, Wiley, Taylor and Francis, MDPI, and Frontiers; comparative analysis with sovereign research initiatives in China, Germany, France, South Korea, and Brazil; and scenario modelling under five-, ten-, and 2047-horizon projections.

Findings. Conservative estimates place annual Indian APC outflows between USD 280 million and USD 460 million, with cumulative outflows toward 2047 plausibly exceeding USD 12 billion in nominal terms (author calculations from publisher annual reports; Springer Nature, 2024; Elsevier Annual Report, 2024). Faculty under CAS regulations confront a documented promotion deadlock created by the regulatory mandate for journal-indexed publications without sovereign provision of validation infrastructure. The Maharashtra state university system, and institutions of the Deccan Education Society, illustrate the micro-level operational pathology of this national policy gap.

Originality. This is among the first studies to model research validation as a DPI primitive, to draft statutory architecture for a sovereign validation rail, and to quantify the fiscal mathematics of academic capital flight under Indian conditions. The paper proposes a National Research Sovereignty Mission (NRSM) and provides a five-year implementation roadmap consistent with NEP 2020, Viksit Bharat 2047, and Atmanirbhar Bharat objectives.

Implications. Project SARASWATI is presented not as a publishing reform but as constitutional, fiscal, and infrastructural reform. Its operationalisation would advance research access equity, multilingual scholarship across India's twenty-two scheduled languages, and intergenerational knowledge sovereignty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估了“SARASWATI计划”——一个印度主权数字公共基础设施（DPI），旨在作为印度科技栈中缺失的“研究层”。研究发现，印度学者每年因支付文章处理费（APC）向外国商业出版商流出2.8亿至4.6亿美元，并提出了国家研究主权使命（NRSM）及五年实施路线图。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个主权研究验证数字公共基础设施（Project SARASWATI），以解决印度学术成果验证依赖外国商业出版商所带来的资本外流、财政悖论和制度僵局？
AI.motivation: 印度已构建了身份、支付、文件保管等数字公共基础设施，但学术研究验证仍依赖外国控制的商业出版基础设施，导致每年巨额资本外流（2.8亿至4.6亿美元），同时UGC的职称晋升制度（CAS）强制要求期刊索引发表，却未提供主权验证基础设施，造成教师晋升困境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字公共基础设施（DPI）理论、研究验证作为DPI原语的概念化、主权知识基础设施理论、制度经济学中的路径依赖与锁定效应。
AI.method: 多方法框架：教义法律分析（UGC法案、NEP 2020、国家研究基金会框架）；制度分析（马哈拉施特拉邦四所大学）；计量经济学建模（基于Elsevier、Springer Nature等六家出版商公开定价数据的APC外流估算）；国际比较分析（中国、德国、法国、韩国、巴西）；情景建模（五年、十年、2047年预测）。
AI.findings: 印度年度APC外流保守估计为2.8亿至4.6亿美元，到2047年累计外流可能超过120亿美元；CAS制度强制要求期刊索引发表但无主权验证基础设施，造成教师晋升僵局；马哈拉施特拉邦大学系统体现了这一国家政策缺口的微观病理。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将研究验证建模为数字公共基础设施（DPI）原语；首次为主权验证轨道起草法定架构；首次量化印度情境下学术资本外流的财政数学。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出国家研究主权使命（NRSM）及符合NEP 2020、Viksit Bharat 2047和Atmanirbhar Bharat目标的五年实施路线图；提出Project SARASWATI作为宪法、财政和基础设施改革方案，将促进研究获取公平、多语种学术及代际知识主权。

title: Debt Sustainability as a Recursive Compatibility Problem

detail.title: Debt Sustainability as a Recursive Compatibility Problem
detail.abstract:
Debt sustainability in private-sector fiat-credit economies is typically assessed through debt burdens, debt-service requirements, or repayment capacity. Yet these indicators may only partially characterize the conditions through which financial obligations remain recurrently serviceable over time.

This paper develops a circulation-based interpretation of debt sustainability centered on recursive compatibility and recurrent debt validation. Sustainability is conceptualized as a compatibility problem between outstanding financial obligations and the circulation and repayment conditions through which debt servicing remains recurrently feasible. A central implication follows: broadly similar debt environments need not imply similar sustainability conditions.

The empirical analysis uses quarterly data for eighteen advanced economies over 1999Q1–2023Q4. Conventional debt metrics explain only a limited share of subsequent debt-validation dynamics, while recursive compatibility contributes additional diagnostic information beyond broader structural benchmarks — differentiating sustainability conditions among economies facing comparable contemporaneous repayment burdens. The strongest empirical support emerges for subsequent debt-validation pressure, the outcome most directly implied by the framework.

The framework lends itself to real-time monitoring using publicly available macro-financial data. A pseudo-real-time application to 2007Q4 illustrates how recursive compatibility differentiates sustainability configurations across advanced economies immediately before the Global Financial Crisis, separating cases of hidden fragility from hidden resilience under broadly comparable observable pressure conditions.

More broadly, the findings suggest that similar observable debt conditions need not imply similar sustainability conditions. Recursive compatibility provides additional information about how financial obligations remain recurrently serviceable through time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于循环相容性的私人部门法币信用经济债务可持续性分析框架，认为债务可持续性取决于金融义务与流通/偿付条件之间的递归兼容性。使用18个发达经济体1999-2023年数据验证，发现传统债务指标只能解释有限的债务验证动态，而递归相容性提供了额外的诊断信息，尤其在2007年全球金融危机前能区分看似相似债务环境下的隐性脆弱性与韧性。
AI.research_question: 如何从流通循环的角度理解私人部门法币信用经济中的债务可持续性？递归相容性能否提供超越传统债务指标的额外诊断信息？
AI.motivation: 传统债务可持续性评估主要关注债务负担、偿债要求或偿还能力等指标，但这些指标可能仅部分刻画了金融义务在时间上持续可偿付的条件。需要更全面的理论框架来理解债务可持续性的内在机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于流通循环的债务可持续性解释：将可持续性概念化为未偿金融义务与流通和偿付条件之间的递归相容性问题，强调债务的递归验证（recurrent debt validation）。核心观点是相似的债务环境不一定意味着相似的可持续性条件。
AI.method: 使用18个发达经济体1999Q1-2023Q4的季度数据进行实证分析。比较传统债务指标与递归相容性指标对后续债务验证动态的解释力。伪实时应用：将框架应用于2007Q4以检验全球金融危机前的债务可持续性配置。
AI.findings: （1）传统债务指标只能解释有限的后续债务验证动态；（2）递归相容性在更广泛的结构基准之外提供了额外的诊断信息，能区分面临相似偿债负担的经济体之间的可持续性差异；（3）递归相容性对后续债务验证压力（框架最直接隐含的结果）的实证支持最强；（4）2007Q4的伪实时应用显示，递归相容性能在相似可观察压力条件下区分隐性脆弱性与韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于流通循环和递归相容性的债务可持续性新理论框架，挑战了传统债务指标评估可持续性的充分性，揭示了相似债务环境可能隐含不同可持续性条件的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 该框架可利用公开的宏观金融数据进行实时监测；伪实时应用展示了其在金融危机前识别隐性脆弱性与韧性的实用性，对政策制定者和市场参与者的风险监测具有重要参考价值。

title: From Social Abandonment to Algorithmic Abandonment: Digital Capitalism, Human Belonging, and the Capture of Human Identity
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: From Social Abandonment to Algorithmic Abandonment: Digital Capitalism, Human Belonging, and the Capture of Human Identity

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. The author has no personal, financial, institutional, or organisational relationships that could be perceived to have influenced this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not involve human participants, interviews, clinical data, private personal data, experiments, or case-study participants. It is a conceptual and policy-oriented research paper based on publicly available literature and theoretical analysis. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was independently prepared by the author as part of the Osama S. Qatrani Independent Research Project / Third Generation in International Relations research work.

keywords: and algorithmic identity systems reshape human presence

detail.abstract:
This preprint develops the concept of algorithmic abandonment as a critical and theoretical extension of social abandonment in contemporary digital society. It begins from Dr Cora M. Stack’s policy framework on loneliness, social abandonment, and Inclusive Community Belonging Hubs in Ireland, and uses Gretta Mohan’s ESRI-supported work on loneliness and mental health as an empirical Irish starting point.

The paper argues that digital capitalism, platform life, automation, artificial intelligence, and algorithmic identity systems do not merely intensify loneliness; they reorganise the conditions of belonging by replacing embodied presence with mediated, personalised, and data-producing forms of connection. It introduces the Algorithmic Abandonment Cycle as a six-stage framework and connects it to the IAAP model: Identity in the Age of Algorithmic Power.

The paper is conceptual and policy-oriented rather than empirical. It does not present new survey data, interviews, or clinical findings. Instead, it defines a new research problem, proposes operational indicators, develops future research propositions, and outlines policy principles for anti-abandonment and anti-capture design. Its central claim is that belonging should be treated as human infrastructure, and that digital tools should support embodied human connection rather than replace it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"算法性遗弃"这一概念，作为社会遗弃在数字社会的批判性理论延伸。它认为数字资本主义、平台生活、人工智能和算法身份系统不仅加剧了孤独感，更通过用中介化、个性化且产生数据的连接方式取代具身化在场，重组了归属的条件。文章提出了六阶段"算法性遗弃循环"框架与"算法权力时代的身份"模型，并从政策设计角度主张将归属感视为人类基础设施，数字工具应支持而非替代具身化的人际连接。
AI.research_question: 数字技术和算法系统如何在社会层面重新组织（而非仅仅加剧）孤独与归属的条件？如何从理论与实践上界定"算法性遗弃"这一新兴社会问题？
AI.motivation: 现有的关于孤独和社会遗弃的研究尚未充分关注数字资本主义、平台经济和算法系统如何系统性地重新配置人际关系，而非简单地放大个体孤独感。作者希望弥补这一理论空白，并为政策制定提供新的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会遗弃理论、算法权力理论、归属感作为人类基础设施的视角。核心框架包括：算法性遗弃循环（六阶段框架）和算法权力时代的身份模型（IAAP模型）。
AI.method: 概念性研究和政策导向分析，而非经验实证研究。通过理论整合与框架构建来定义研究问题、提出操作性指标、发展未来研究命题以及概述政策原则。
AI.findings: 数字资本主义和算法系统通过用非具身化的、数据驱动的连接方式取代真实的人际在场，系统性地重组了归属条件；提出了算法性遗弃循环作为理解这一过程的分析工具；主张归属感应被视作"人类基础设施"，并据此提出了反遗弃和反捕获的设计原则。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将"社会遗弃"概念拓展至数字时代，提出了"算法性遗弃"这一新概念；构建了算法性遗弃循环（六阶段）和IAAP模型两个分析框架；重新定义了数字时代归属感问题的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了可操作的分析工具与评估指标；提出了反遗弃和反捕获的设计原则，用于指导数字工具的设计应支持而非替代具身化连接；为爱尔兰及更广泛地区的孤独与社会包容政策提供了新的理论支撑和方向建议。

title: Multinational Firms' Strategic Production Configuration with Considerations of Multilateral Tariffs and RCEP
affiliations: Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU), Sun Yat-sen University, University of Texas at Austin - McCombs School of Business and Sun Yat-sen University

detail.title: Multinational Firms' Strategic Production Configuration with Considerations of Multilateral Tariffs and RCEP
detail.abstract: In the context of escalating Sino-U.S. trade frictions and the implementation of the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP), many multinational firms (MNFs) are restructuring their global production networks by shifting manufacturing capacity from China to Southeast Asia. Motivated by this observation, we develop a model featuring three countries/regions-China, the U.S., and Southeast Asia-and a two-tier supply chain consisting of two competing MNFs and a key component supplier located in China. The model systematically examines MNFs' production location strategies under such a multilateral tariff environment. The two MNFs serve both the Chinese and U.S. markets and face a critical trade-off in production location decisions. Maintaining production in China secures local market advantages but results in higher export tariffs to the U.S. market. Conversely, relocating production to Southeast Asia lowers tariffs when exporting to the U.S., but makes exports to China subject to tariffs. Tariffs on exports to China are expected to decline gradually with the progressive implementation of RCEP. Our results show that MNFs have incentives to differentiate their production locations to alleviate global market competition. Their equilibrium production configurations-which may be symmetric or asymmetric-are primarily shaped by China's tariff disadvantage, global market conditions, and export tariffs from Southeast Asia to China. Interestingly, under certain conditions, further tariff liberalization under RCEP can induce MNFs to switch production locations twice: first from Southeast Asia to China, and then back to Southeast Asia.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含中美及东南亚三地区、两家竞争性跨国公司与一家中国关键零部件供应商的两层供应链模型，研究在中美贸易摩擦与RCEP实施背景下跨国公司的生产区位选择策略。研究发现跨国公司有动机通过差异化生产区位来缓解全球市场竞争，且RCEP关税自由化在特定条件下会诱导企业出现"先迁回中国、再迁至东南亚"的双重转移现象。
AI.research_question: 在多边关税环境下（中美贸易摩擦与RCEP实施），跨国公司的生产区位选择策略及其均衡配置如何？
AI.motivation: 现实中大量跨国公司正将制造产能从中国转移至东南亚，但这一现象背后的理论机制尚未被系统研究，特别是多边关税环境与供应链结构如何影响企业的生产区位决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于三层国家（中、美、东南亚）、两层供应链（两家竞争性跨国公司+中国关键部件供应商）的博弈模型，涵盖关税壁垒、市场竞争、区位优势等理论要素。
AI.method: 理论建模与博弈分析，构建多国家、多企业的供应链博弈模型，求解均衡生产区位配置。
AI.findings: （1）跨国公司有动机通过差异化生产区位来缓解全球市场竞争；（2）均衡配置（对称或非对称）主要受中国关税劣势、全球市场条件以及东南亚对华出口关税的影响；（3）RCEP进一步关税自由化在特定条件下会诱导企业出现两次生产区位转换：先从东南亚迁回中国，再从中国迁回东南亚。
AI.theory_contributions: 将多边关税环境（贸易摩擦与区域贸易协定并存）与供应链竞争纳入统一分析框架，揭示了生产区位"双重转换"的非单调动态机制，丰富了国际生产区位选择与全球供应链重构的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨国公司在复杂贸易政策环境下的生产布局决策提供理论指导，也为政策制定者理解RCEP关税减让对区域产业链转移的潜在影响提供参考依据。

title: Capital Markets LLM Reliability Score (CM-LRS): From Plausible to Bankable

detail.title: Capital Markets LLM Reliability Score (CM-LRS): From Plausible to Bankable

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is a practitioner in investment banking working on AI and data systems. This research was conducted independently in a personal capacity and does not represent the views of any employer. The author has no financial relationship with, and received no compensation from, any of the model providers or vendors referenced. No models or vendors were evaluated under any commercial arrangement.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: In capital-markets workflows, the question is rarely whether an LLM can produce a fluent draft. Today's frontier models will draft a debt-terms table, a comparable-transactions writeup, or an issuer profile that reads smoothly on first pass. The harder question is whether the draft is bankable: whether a banker, analyst, or compliance reviewer can defend it in front of a counter-party or a regulator, with the underlying documents in hand. Bankability requires the claims to trace back to verifiable source passages, the numbers to reconcile, the requested workflow to be completed in full, the model to have added nothing the source does not support, the output to be useful for a downstream decision, and the whole package to be verifiable by a domain expert in minutes rather than hours. Current LLM evaluation methods address parts of that gap but not the whole of it. Open-domain QA benchmarks reward surface accuracy. Finance-domain benchmarks (Fi-nanceBench, FinQA, ConvFinQA) advance document-grounded and numerical QA but evaluate at the question-answer pair layer. Multi-dimensional rubric studies of finance LLMs exist but are anchored on QA-style tasks rather than the workflow outputs bankers and analysts actually defend in front of reviewers, counter-parties, and regulators. This paper introduces CM-LRS, a Capital Markets LLM Reliability Score. CM-LRS evaluates LLM outputs at the workflow-output layer across seven reliability dimensions: factual accuracy, evidence traceability, numerical consistency, workflow completeness, source discipline, decision usefulness, and reviewability/auditability. Each dimension is scored 0-5 against a rubric anchored on practical signals reviewers in regulated environments actually use. The aggregate is tunable to the workflow under evaluation. We demonstrate CM-LRS on five representative capital-markets workflows: DCM transactionterms extraction, precedent retrieval, issuer profile synthesis, M&A transaction-comparable reasoning, and ECM transaction-terms extraction. All inputs are public: SEC EDGAR filings, a public UK takeover IR release, and obviously-fictional synthetic Nordic-style supplements to support strict reproducibility. We score outputs from four models: Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5.5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and the open-weights Llama 3.3 70B Instruct. Three findings of practical relevance for capital-markets buyers, established by scoring outputs against four independent LLM judges spanning three model families (Sonnet 4.6 and GPT-5.5 in-panel; Haiku 4.5 and Gemini 2.5 Pro out-of-panel) to control for self-and family-bias. First, the three frontier closed-source models cluster within a 0.22-point band on four-judge averaged CM-LRS (Sonnet 4.6 = 4.31, Opus 4.7 = 4.30, GPT-5.5 = 4.09); all four judges agree the open-weights baseline (Llama 3.3 70B at 3.15) is last. Second, the open-weights gap is concentrated on retrieval and synthesis class workflows, not extraction: under the primary judge the gap is 2.23 points on retrieval, 2.15 on synthesis, only 0.84 on the simplest extraction workflow. Third, Decision Usefulness (D6), the dimension that asks whether a reviewer would actually act on the output without major rework, shows the widest cross-model dispersion of any dimension in any workflow (a 4.0-point spread on the issuer-profile workflow alone) and sits in the top tier of inter-judge agreement (mean Pearson r = 0.52 across the six judge pairs, within 0.02 of the highest dimension). The combination is what makes D6 the cleanest dimension-level production-readiness signal in the rubric. Plausibility is cheap.  Bankability is the bar. CM-LRS is a deployment-readiness metric for high-stakes regulated environments, and is released with all rubrics, prompts, and demonstration tasks public.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CM-LRS（资本市场LLM可靠性评分），从七个维度（事实准确性、证据可追溯性、数值一致性、工作流完整性、来源纪律、决策有用性、可审计性）评估LLM在高风险金融工作流中的输出质量，并基于四个模型和五个工作流进行了实证分析。
AI.research_question: 在资本市场的实际工作流中，LLM的输出是否具备"可银行化"——即是否可追溯、可验证、可被领域专家在几分钟而非几小时内审查通过？
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评估方法（如开放域QA基准、金融领域QA基准、多维评分研究）只评估问答对层面的表面准确性，而非实际工作流输出（如债务条款提取、发行人简介、可比交易分析等）的整体可靠性，无法满足监管环境中对"可银行化"的要求。
AI.theoretical_framework: CM-LRS七维度可靠性评分框架：事实准确性、证据可追溯性、数值一致性、工作流完整性、来源纪律、决策有用性、可审计性。
AI.method: 在五个资本市场工作流（DCM交易条款提取、先例检索、发行人简介合成、M&A可比交易推理、ECM交易条款提取）上，用四个LLM（Claude Opus 4.7、GPT-5.5、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Llama 3.3 70B Instruct）生成输出，再由四名独立评判模型（Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.5、Haiku 4.5、Gemini 2.5 Pro）按CM-LRS七维度打分（0-5分），控制自评偏差和族偏差。
AI.findings: （1）三家前沿闭源模型得分差距极小（4.09-4.31），开源基线（Llama 3.3 70B）明显落后（3.15）；（2）开源模型在检索和合成类工作流上的差距远大于简单提取类工作流（差距2.23 vs 0.84）；（3）决策有用性维度（D6）是区分度最大的维度（单一工作流上跨模型差距达4.0分），也是评判者间一致性最高的维度之一，是最清晰的生产就绪信号。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出了面向资本市场工作流层面的LLM可靠性评估框架（CM-LRS），超越了传统的问答对级别评估，填补了高风险监管环境中LLM输出"可银行化"评估的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构采购LLM提供了可操作的评估指标体系；开源了所有评分规则、提示词和演示任务，便于行业复现和定制；实证揭示了闭源与开源模型在不同工作流类型上的实际差距，为资本市场的AI部署决策提供了依据。

title: The Impact of Chronic Workplace Stress on Employee Productivity and Efficiency

detail.title: The Impact of Chronic Workplace Stress on Employee Productivity and Efficiency
detail.abstract: In modern organizations, stress at work is a growing concern and has great effects on employee wellness and work efficiency (Colligan and Higgins 91). This study focuses on the effect of chronic occupational stress on productivity, efficiency, job satisfaction, absenteeism and organizational outcomes. The aim is to assess the correlation between chronic stress exposure and performance in the workplace and the impact of stress management techniques. In terms of methodologically, the study is based on secondary data, both qualitative and quantitative, which are obtained from peer-reviewed journals and organizational reports. The approach is a comparative analysis of stress related productivity outcomes in several industries such as healthcare, education, manufacturing and corporate services. This cross-sector vision enables one to gain a broader understanding of the different ways in which stress can present in the various contexts and demands of work. The results show that significant employee performance losses due to chronic work stress are not only in terms of their efficiency but also on their morale, creativity, physical health, absenteeism and organizational output (Daniel 377). But there is also some evidence that structured stress management programs (including employee assistance programs, workload restructuring, and wellness programs) can significantly affect productivity and employee well-being (Timotius and Octavius 194). To sum up, companies that make an effort to actively focus on employee stress reduction tend to have more engaged employees, better performance, and a more long-lasting productivity over time. The results emphasize leadership commitment and organizational culture as crucial factors in reducing stress-related risks and ensuring long-term productivity of the workforce.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于二手数据，分析了不同行业中慢性职业压力对员工生产力、效率、工作满意度、缺勤率及组织绩效的影响，发现慢性工作压力会显著损害员工绩效，而结构化的压力管理项目（如员工援助计划、工作量重组、健康计划）能有效改善生产力和员工幸福感。
AI.research_question: 慢性职业压力如何影响员工的生产力、效率、工作满意度、缺勤率及组织绩效？压力管理技术能否缓解这些负面影响？
AI.motivation: 现代组织中工作压力日益严重，对员工福祉和工作效率产生巨大影响，因此需要系统评估慢性压力与职场表现之间的关联，并探索压力管理措施的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于职业压力理论、员工绩效理论及压力管理理论，探讨压力-绩效关系及压力干预机制。
AI.method: 采用二手数据分析，结合定性和定量方法，从同行评审期刊和组织报告中获取数据，对医疗、教育、制造和企业服务等多个行业进行压力相关生产力结果的比较分析。
AI.findings: 慢性工作压力显著导致员工效率下降、士气低落、创造力降低、身体健康受损、缺勤率上升及组织产出减少；而结构化的压力管理项目（员工援助计划、工作量重组、健康计划）能够显著改善生产力和员工幸福感；注重减轻员工压力的公司往往拥有更敬业的员工、更好的绩效和更持久的长期生产力。
AI.theory_contributions: 跨行业比较分析证实了慢性职业压力对多维绩效指标的普遍负面影响，同时验证了压力管理干预的有效性，丰富了对压力-绩效关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供了实证依据，强调领导承诺和组织文化在降低压力风险中的关键作用，建议企业实施结构化的压力管理项目以提升长期生产力。

title: Exploring Growth Mindset-Related Themes in Teacher Education Training of SY 2021-2022 English Pre-Service Teachers of CBSUA

detail.title: Exploring Growth Mindset-Related Themes in Teacher Education Training of SY 2021-2022 English Pre-Service Teachers of CBSUA
detail.abstract: The study examined how growth mindset-related themes were manifested in the reflective consciousness of the first batch of Enhanced K-to-12 English Pre-Service Teachers (PSTs) of the Central Bikol State University of Agriculture (CBSUA) Calabanga in the second semester of the school year 2021-2022. A meso-level qualitative research design, discourse and content analyses were used to analyze 30 reflective portfolios of 10 randomly selected fourth-year English PSTs, including their weekly internship logs and reflections on the Philippine Professional Standards for Teachers (PPST) domains. Data were analyzed using deductive thematic analysis and values coding based on an adapted framework of growth mindset indicators from Rutherford (2019). The analysis showed seven major growth mindset-related themes significantly intertwined with the training experiences of the PSTs: navigating role changes in teaching, learning from failures, dealing with personal limitations, and embracing challenges in the practicum.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了菲律宾CBSUA大学首批K-12英语职前教师在实习反思中体现的成长型思维主题，发现了七个与教学实践紧密相关的成长型思维表现主题。
AI.research_question: 在首批增强型K-12英语职前教师的反思意识中，成长型思维相关主题是如何体现的？
AI.motivation: 探讨职前教师在实习培训过程中成长型思维的表现，以理解思维模式对教师专业发展的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Rutherford（2019）的成长型思维指标框架，采用演绎主题分析和价值观编码。
AI.method: 中观层面定性研究设计，采用话语分析和内容分析，对10名四年级英语职前教师的30份反思档案（含实习日志和PPST反思）进行演绎主题分析。
AI.findings: 发现七个主要成长型思维主题：应对教学角色转变、从失败中学习、应对个人局限、拥抱实习中的挑战等。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了成长型思维理论在教师教育领域的应用，验证了成长型思维框架在分析职前教师反思中的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教师教育项目设计实习培训方案提供参考，帮助培养职前教师的成长型思维以提升教学质量。

title: The Crypt of the Symbolic: Signifying Absence, Narrative Desire, and the Limits of Sexual Ontology in Barthes's S/Z and Balzac's Sarrasine

detail.title: The Crypt of the Symbolic: Signifying Absence, Narrative Desire, and the Limits of Sexual Ontology in Barthes's S/Z and Balzac's Sarrasine
detail.abstract: To open Roland Barthes’s S/Z is to step into a textual labyrinth where the very notion of the book as a closed vessel of meaning is methodically dismantled. Barthes does not simply interpret Honoré de Balzac’s 1830 novella Sarrasine; he dismembers it into 561 fragments, or lexias, and traces through them the movement of five interweaving codes. This gesture is far more than a technical innovation in narratology. It is a philosophical intervention that recasts the act of reading as an encounter with the plural, the irresolvable, and the radically other. Barthes’s famous opening pronouncement — “the text is a galaxy of signifiers, not a structure of signifieds; it has no beginning; it is reversible; we gain access to it by several entrances, none of which can be authoritatively declared to be the main one” (Barthes, 1974, p. 5) — announces a shift from a hermeneutics of depth to a semiotics of surface and dissemination. In place of the critic who excavates a hidden truth, Barthes installs the reader as a producer of meaning, a subject whose desire is both solicited and perpetually deferred by the play of the codes. The choice of Balzac’s little-known tale is itself strategic: Sarrasine revolves around a secret that, once unveiled, does not resolve the narrative’s tensions but rather deepens them into an abyss of undecidability. A passionate sculptor falls in love with an opera singer whose radiant femininity is revealed to be a performance, a surface without the anticipated anatomical foundation. The body that should anchor the truth of sex becomes instead a void, a figure of radical alterity that collapses the binary of masculine and feminine and exposes the frailty of the symbolic order that relies on that distinction. The present essay undertakes a layered reading of Barthes’s reading, mobilizing the full theoretical apparatus of poststructuralism, psychoanalysis, feminist philosophy, and biopolitical critique to argue that the enigma at the heart of Sarrasine is not the mere secret of a disguised identity but the traumatic unveiling of the lack that constitutes all identity. Through an engagement with Lacan’s logic of the signifier, Derrida’s economy of the supplement, Irigaray’s critique of specularization, Kristeva’s analytics of abjection, Butler’s theory of performativity, Foucault’s genealogy of biopower, and the countersexual provocations of Paul B. Preciado, this essay will demonstrate that the “secret” of the narrative body is the truth of the symbolic itself: that the phallic function, far from being a substantial attribute, is a vacancy that organizes the field of meaning only through its veiling. Barthes’s S/Z, in this light, becomes a propaedeutic for a post-phallogocentric ethics of reading, an invitation to inhabit the text not as a solved equation but as an inexhaustible source of jouissance, a site where the binary machinery of gender and sexuality is both staged and subverted.

AI.tldr: 本文对巴特《S/Z》进行后结构主义重读，论证文本/身体的"秘密"并非隐藏的真相，而是能指链中根本性的缺失。巴特将巴尔扎克《萨拉辛》拆解为561个语汇，揭示性别、身份和意义都是没有锚定的表演，最终指向一种后菲勒斯中心主义的阅读伦理。
AI.research_question: 《S/Z》中巴特对巴尔扎克《萨拉辛》的阅读如何揭示了文本、身体与性别身份的"秘密"本质上是符号秩序中构成性缺失（lack）的创伤性展露？
AI.motivation: 传统阅读将文本视为封闭的意义容器，批评家是"挖掘隐藏真理"的阐释者。巴特通过拆解《萨拉辛》中变性歌手这一"秘密"，挑战了性别/身份的二元对立与基础主义（foundationalism），为后结构主义阅读伦理提供入口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 后结构主义（巴特、德里达的补充经济学、拉康的能指逻辑）、精神分析（拉康的缺失与菲勒斯功能）、女性主义哲学（伊里加蕾的镜像化批判、克里斯蒂娃的贱斥分析）、性别展演理论（巴特勒）、生命政治批判（福柯的biopower）、反性/别理论（普雷西亚多的反性/别挑衅）。
AI.method: 分层阅读（layered reading）：对巴特的阅读进行再阅读，动员后结构主义、精神分析、女性主义哲学和生命政治批判的完整理论装置，以文本细读与理论对话相结合的方式展开论证。
AI.findings: 《萨拉辛》中歌剧歌手的"秘密"不是一个伪装的身份，而是构成一切身份的"缺失"的创伤性展露；菲勒斯功能不是实质性属性，而是一个通过遮蔽来组织意义场的空位；《S/Z》是后菲勒斯中心主义阅读伦理的预备性文本（propaedeutic），邀请读者将文本视为无尽的欢愉（jouissance）源泉，而非可解的方程式。
AI.theory_contributions: 将巴特的《S/Z》从纯粹叙事学技术革新提升为后结构主义哲学干预；整合拉康、德里达、伊里加蕾、克里斯蒂娃、巴特勒、福柯、普雷西亚多等多重理论资源，构建"后菲勒斯中心主义阅读伦理"的理论框架；揭示"文本即身体"隐喻中性别/性与符号秩序的共构关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为当代批评实践提供一种替代性阅读范式：阅读不是破解（破解）而是生产，不是追求确定意义而是栖居于意义的不可决断性；对性别研究和批判理论的交叉研究具有方法论启示。

title: The Problem with Zero: How Xi's Pandemic Policy Created a Crisis for the Regime
affiliations: Johns Hopkins University

detail.title: The Problem with Zero: How Xi's Pandemic Policy Created a Crisis for the Regime
detail.abstract:
This is a preprint / author manuscript version of an essay published in Foreign Affairs. It is provided in text-only form and is not the publisher-formatted final version. The original publication is acknowledged and linked where available.

China's zero-COVID policy—rigidly enforced long after the rest of the world had adapted to the virus—was not primarily a public health strategy. Yuen Yuen Ang argues that it represented a paradigm-level governance failure rooted in the pathologies of overcentralized "directed improvisation." Once Xi Jinping personally staked his political authority on a singular numerical target, the bureaucracy abandoned adaptive problem-solving in favor of systemic gaming. Officials enforced draconian lockdowns not to optimize public health outcomes, but to maintain the leader's "holy zero."

Ang traces how directed improvisation—China's most effective governing mechanism under Deng Xiaoping, which successfully balanced top-down mandates with bottom-up experimentation—collapsed under Xi's rigid command-and-control apparatus. Exercising power as centralized as Mao Zedong's, yet armed with unprecedented high-tech state capacity, Xi engineered an environment of perverse bureaucratic incentives: enforcing zero-COVID yielded political rewards, while questioning it invited severe punishment. The November 2022 White Paper protests, marking the broadest cross-class mobilization since Tiananmen in 1989, exposed the accumulated socioeconomic costs of this governance breakdown. Outlining three potential scenarios for China's post-protest political trajectory, Ang concludes that Xi has inadvertently demonstrated the intrinsic value of limited freedom to the Chinese populace—scattering ideological seeds that will prove difficult for the state to uproot.

AI.tldr: 本文论证中国"动态清零"政策并非主要出于公共卫生考量，而是一场根源于"定向即兴"治理模式崩溃的范式级治理失败。在习近平将政治权威系于单一数字目标后，官僚体系为维护"神圣清零"而实施严苛封锁，最终引发2022年11月白纸运动，并向中国民众展示了有限自由的固有价值。
AI.research_question: 中国"动态清零"政策的本质是什么？它反映了怎样的治理范式问题？
AI.motivation: 解释中国为何在全球适应病毒后仍长期僵化执行清零政策，揭示其背后的政治与治理逻辑，而非简单的公共卫生解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: "定向即兴"（directed improvisation）治理理论——一种结合顶层指令与基层实验的机制；治理范式失败理论；官僚激励机制扭曲理论。
AI.method: 定性分析，基于对中国政治体系运作机制的理论阐释和历史比较分析（对比邓小平时代与习近平时代的治理模式）。
AI.findings: "动态清零"是一场治理范式级失败；习近平时代的高度集权与高科技监控能力结合，制造了扭曲的官僚激励；2022年白纸运动是1989年以来最广泛的跨阶层动员；习近平无意中向民众展示了有限自由的价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"定向即兴"概念应用于解释中国治理模式的演变与崩溃；揭示了高度集权下官僚体系"系统性博弈"（systemic gaming）的行为机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解中国政治体制的内在脆弱性提供了分析框架；对预测中国后抗议时期的政治走向（三种可能情景）提供了参考。

title: The Normalisation of Debt-Financed Status Consumption: Social Media, Household Saving, and the Behaviour of Young Urban India
affiliations: Ramrao Adik Institute of Technology, Navi Mumbai, India

detail.title: The Normalisation of Debt-Financed Status Consumption: Social Media, Household Saving, and the Behaviour of Young Urban India
detail.abstract: This paper examines how social media has reshaped the consumption and saving behaviour of young urban India, arguing that it has normalised a pattern of aspirational consumption that exceeds current income and is financed by instalment debt under conditions where that debt consumes a disproportionate share of earnings, erodes precautionary buffers, and blurs the boundary between what a household can afford and what it cannot. The analysis distinguishes consumption utility from signalling utility and locates the cost in the latter. Drawing on Reserve Bank of India household-savings data, Securities and Exchange Board of India retail-derivatives loss studies, the live-events and buy-now-paylater markets, and the regulatory record on financial influencers, the paper documents the pattern across five domains. Consequences are assessed in two stages: near-term household and life-cycle effects, and long-term macroeconomic effects as the cohort enters its primary earning years while the national savings pool remains below its pre-pandemic trend and the population ages. Three counterarguments are addressed. The paper concludes that the normalisation of debt-financed status consumption, under the conditions identified, is costly to households and constitutes a structural macroeconomic vulnerability for India.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了社交媒体如何重塑印度年轻城市群体的消费与储蓄行为，指出其将"收入不足、借贷消费、信号效用优先"的模式正常化，造成家庭财务脆弱性和宏观结构性风险。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体如何改变印度年轻城市群体的消费与储蓄行为？这种改变带来了哪些近期的家庭层面影响和长期的宏观经济后果？
AI.motivation: 社交媒体日益成为消费行为的重要塑造力量，但对其如何通过信号效用与债务融资机制影响年轻群体储蓄行为的系统性研究不足，尤其在新兴市场背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费效用与信号效用的区分理论（Veblen效应、地位消费理论）；生命周期储蓄理论；家庭资产负债表脆弱性分析框架。
AI.method: 多源数据综合分析：印度央行家庭储蓄数据、印度证券交易委员会零售衍生品亏损研究、现场活动与"先买后付"市场数据、金融网红监管记录。覆盖五个领域进行模式验证。
AI.findings: 社交媒体将"借贷支撑的地位消费"正常化，导致（1）家庭层面：分期债务侵蚀收入、削弱预防性缓冲、模糊负担能力边界；（2）宏观层面：年轻群体进入主要收入期时国家储蓄池低于疫情前趋势，叠加人口老龄化，构成结构性脆弱性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将信号效用理论与社交媒体驱动的消费行为相结合，揭示了数字时代地位消费的新机制——从"炫耀性消费"转向"借贷支撑的炫耀性消费"。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度及类似新兴市场的金融监管、消费者保护政策和宏观审慎管理提供实证依据；警示金融网红监管和"先买后付"信贷风险。

title: Interprofessional Knowledge Formation in Child Welfare Client Networks and Teams
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN
